        "preprocessing": dict(preprocessing),
        "quality_record_endpoint": dict(quality_endpoint),
        "runtime_artifacts": runtime_artifacts,
        "runtime_artifact_set_sha256": runtime_artifact_set_sha256,
        "endpoint_contract": endpoint,
        "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
        "runtime_precision_identity": precision,
        "implementation_runner_sha256": implementation_runner["sha256"],
        "implementation_runner_size_bytes": implementation_runner["size_bytes"],
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract": completion,
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract_sha256": completion_sha,
        "quality_contract": quality,
        "quality_contract_sha256": quality_sha,
        "preprocessing_contract_sha256": str(
            quality.get("preprocessing_contract_sha256")
            or preprocessing.get("sha256") or ""
        ).strip().lower(),
        "decoder_contract_sha256": str(
            quality.get("decoder_contract_sha256")
            or (quality.get("decoder") or {}).get("sha256") or ""
        ).strip().lower(),
        "nms_contract_sha256": str(
            quality.get("nms_contract_sha256")
            or (quality.get("nms") or {}).get("sha256") or ""
        ).strip().lower(),
        "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": str(
            quality.get("quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256")
            or quality_endpoint.get("sha256") or ""
        ).strip().lower(),
    }
    return (
        {
            **producer_identity,
            "producer_identity_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(
                producer_identity
            ),
        },
        completion,
    )


def _portable_dataset_manifest_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    """Hash dataset identity without binding it to one host filesystem.

    Current campaign manifests already seal every selected sample by stable
    sample ID, relative path and content SHA-256.  Hashing the JSON file itself
    additionally seals ``root``, annotation paths and creation timestamps, so
    an otherwise byte-identical dataset copied from the management host to an
    accelerator receives a different scientific identity.  Use the verified
    content-addressed subset instead.  Unknown/legacy manifest schemas retain
    their historical byte hash rather than being guessed portable.
    """
    manifest_path = Path(path)
    payload = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (
        not isinstance(payload, Mapping)
        or payload.get("schema") != "onnx-splitpoint/dataset-manifest"
        or not isinstance(payload.get("items"), list)
        or not payload.get("items")
    ):
        return _quality_file_sha256(manifest_path)

    identity_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    legacy_identity_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    legacy_writer_shape = True
    for raw in payload["items"]:
        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
            raise RuntimeError("dataset manifest contains a non-object item")
        raw_digest = raw.get("sha256")
        raw_sample_id = raw.get("sample_id")
        raw_relative_path = raw.get("relative_path")
        raw_class_name = raw.get("class_name", "")
        digest_is_bare = bool(
            isinstance(raw_digest, str)
            and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", raw_digest)
        )
        digest_is_legacy = bool(
            isinstance(raw_digest, str)
            and re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", raw_digest)
        )
        if not (digest_is_bare or digest_is_legacy):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "portable dataset identity requires per-item content SHA-256"
            )
        if (
            not isinstance(raw_sample_id, str)
            or not raw_sample_id
            or raw_sample_id != raw_sample_id.strip()
            or not isinstance(raw_relative_path, str)
            or not raw_relative_path
            or raw_relative_path != raw_relative_path.strip()
            or raw_relative_path.startswith("/")
            or "\\" in raw_relative_path
            or any(
                part in {"", ".", ".."}
                for part in raw_relative_path.split("/")
            )
            or not isinstance(raw_class_name, str)
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "portable dataset identity requires sample IDs and relative paths"
            )
        digest = raw_digest[7:] if digest_is_legacy else raw_digest
        identity_rows.append({
            "sample_id": raw_sample_id,
            "relative_path": raw_relative_path,
            "sha256": digest,
            "class_name": raw_class_name,
        })
        legacy_identity_rows.append({
            "sample_id": raw.get("sample_id"),
            "relative_path": raw.get("relative_path"),
            "sha256": raw.get("sha256", ""),
            "class_name": raw.get("class_name", ""),
        })
        legacy_writer_shape = legacy_writer_shape and digest_is_legacy
    items_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(identity_rows)
    legacy_items_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(legacy_identity_rows)
    raw_declared_items_sha = payload.get("items_identity_sha256")
    declared_items_sha = (
        raw_declared_items_sha[7:]
        if isinstance(raw_declared_items_sha, str)
        and raw_declared_items_sha.startswith("sha256:")
        else raw_declared_items_sha
    )
    if not (
        isinstance(declared_items_sha, str)
        and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", declared_items_sha)
        and (
            declared_items_sha == items_sha
            or (
                legacy_writer_shape
                and declared_items_sha == legacy_items_sha
            )
        )
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("dataset manifest item identity SHA-256 mismatch")

    def _component_sha(name: str) -> str:
        component = payload.get(name)
        if not isinstance(component, Mapping):
            return ""
        value = str(component.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
        return value.split(":", 1)[1] if value.startswith("sha256:") else value

    portable_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/portable-dataset-identity",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "dataset_id": str(payload.get("dataset_id") or ""),
        "task": str(payload.get("task") or "").strip().lower(),
        "role": str(payload.get("role") or "").strip().lower(),
        "split": str(payload.get("split") or ""),
        "hash_mode": str(payload.get("hash_mode") or "").strip().lower(),
        "item_count": len(identity_rows),
        "items_identity_sha256": items_sha,
        "annotations_sha256": _component_sha("annotations"),
        "labels_sha256": _component_sha("labels"),
    }
    return _quality_contract_sha256(portable_identity)


def _verified_suite_vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256() -> str:
    """Return the runner-bound attestor digest or fail before export."""
    expected_sha256 = str(
        _EXPECTED_VENDORED_ENDPOINT_ATTESTOR_SHA256 or ""
    ).strip().lower()
    actual_sha256 = str(_endpoint_attestor_sha256 or "").strip().lower()
    attestor_path = Path(str(_endpoint_attestor_path or "")).expanduser()
    if (
        _endpoint_attestor_source != "suite_vendored"
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_sha256)
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", actual_sha256)
        or actual_sha256 != expected_sha256
        or not attestor_path.is_file()
        or _quality_file_sha256(attestor_path.resolve()) != actual_sha256
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central quality endpoint attestor bytes do not match the "
            "runner-embedded suite contract"
        )
    return actual_sha256


def _build_classification_quality_contract(
    *, model_path: Path, validation_source: Path,
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], image_scale: str, letterbox: bool,
    input_hw: Tuple[int, int], input_dtype: Any, runner_path: Path,
    endpoint_attestor_sha256: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Freeze label, preprocessing and Top-K record semantics."""
    model = Path(model_path)
    source = Path(validation_source)
    manifest_path = source / "manifest.json" if source.is_dir() else source
    runner = Path(runner_path)
    if not model.is_file() or not manifest_path.is_file() or not runner.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("central classification quality contract artefact missing")
    records = sorted(
        [
            {
                "image_id": str(row.get("image_id") or row.get("image") or ""),
                "label_id": int(row.get("label_id")) if row.get("label_id") is not None else None,
            }
            for row in rows
            if str(row.get("image_id") or row.get("image") or "")
        ],
        key=lambda item: item["image_id"],
    )
    ids = [item["image_id"] for item in records]
    if not ids or len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or any(item.get("label_id") is None for item in records):
        raise RuntimeError("central classification quality requires unique labelled Image IDs")
    typed_ids = sorted(f"str:{value}" for value in ids)
    runner_sha256 = _quality_file_sha256(runner)
    attestor_sha256 = str(endpoint_attestor_sha256 or "").strip().lower()
    if (
        len(attestor_sha256) != 64
        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in attestor_sha256)
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central classification quality endpoint attestor is invalid"
        )
    # Keep this function AST-extractable for contract-only tests and remote
    # management tooling: do not depend on runner globals beyond the existing
    # hashing helpers.
    preprocessing_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/image-preprocessing-contract",
        "schema_version": 2,
        "contract_scope": "prepared_rgb_uint8_semantics",
        "task": "classification",
        "preprocess_mode": "resize",
        "spatial_transform": "direct_resize",
        "target_hw": [int(input_hw[0]), int(input_hw[1])],
        "color_space": "RGB",
        "input_domain": "uint8_0_255",
        "resize_interpolation": "bilinear",
        "resize_rounding": "python_round_ties_to_even",
        "placement": "not_applicable",
        "pad_value": 0,
        "letterbox_pad_value": 0,
        "image_scale": "imagenet",
        "letterbox": False,
    }
    preprocessing_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(preprocessing_identity)
    if bool(letterbox):
        raise RuntimeError("classification quality cannot use letterbox geometry")
    runtime_input_encoding = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/model-input-encoding-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "image_scale": str(image_scale or ""),
        "input_dtype": str(input_dtype or ""),
    }
    postprocessor_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/classification-topk-postprocessor-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha256,
        "implementation_functions": ["_classification_logits_vector", "_classification_gt_metrics"],
        "canonical_record_endpoint": "classification_topk_hits",
        "topk": 5,
        "sort_order": "score_descending",
    }
    postprocessor_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(postprocessor_identity)
    quality_record_endpoint_identity = {
        "schema": (
            "onnx-splitpoint/"
            "classification-quality-record-endpoint-contract"
        ),
        "schema_version": 1,
        "canonical_record_endpoint": "classification_topk_hits",
        "postprocessor_contract_sha256": postprocessor_sha256,
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha256,
        "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256": attestor_sha256,
    }
    quality_record_endpoint_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(
        quality_record_endpoint_identity
    )
    identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/central-classification-quality-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "task": "classification",
        "model": {"artifact_name": model.name, "sha256": _quality_file_sha256(model)},
        "dataset": {
            "manifest_name": manifest_path.name,
            "manifest_sha256": _portable_dataset_manifest_sha256(
                manifest_path
            ),
            "image_ids_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(typed_ids),
            "ground_truth_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(records),
            "image_count": len(records),
            "class_identity": "label_id",
        },
        "preprocessing": {
            "identity": preprocessing_identity,
            "sha256": preprocessing_sha256,
            "runtime_input_encoding": runtime_input_encoding,
            "runtime_input_encoding_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(runtime_input_encoding),
        },
        "postprocessor": {"identity": postprocessor_identity, "sha256": postprocessor_sha256},
        "quality_record_endpoint": {
            "identity": quality_record_endpoint_identity,
            "sha256": quality_record_endpoint_sha256,
        },
        "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": (
            quality_record_endpoint_sha256
        ),
        "contract_scope": "canonical_quality_record_semantics",
        "canonical_record_endpoint": "classification_topk_hits",
    }
    return {**identity, "quality_contract_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(identity)}


def _require_complete_detection_candidate_adapter(
    *,
    expected_image_ids: Sequence[str],
    candidate_by_image: Mapping[str, Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]],
    per_image_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Fail with the first adapter cause before a secondary ID error hides it."""
    expected = [str(value) for value in expected_image_ids]
    if (
        not expected
        or any(not value for value in expected)
        or len(expected) != len(set(expected))
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central detection candidate adapter received invalid Image IDs"
        )
    observed = {str(value) for value in candidate_by_image}
    expected_set = set(expected)
    missing = sorted(expected_set - observed)
    extra = sorted(observed - expected_set)
    if not missing and not extra:
        return {
            "expected": len(expected),
            "observed": len(observed),
            "missing": 0,
            "extra": 0,
        }

    missing_set = set(missing)
    first_errors: List[str] = []
    error_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in per_image_rows:
        image_id = str(row.get("image") or "")
        error = str(row.get("error") or "").strip()
        if image_id not in missing_set or not error:
            continue
        kind = error.split(":", 1)[0].strip() or "unknown"
        error_counts[kind] = int(error_counts.get(kind) or 0) + 1
        if len(first_errors) < 3:
            first_errors.append(f"{image_id}:{error}")
    raise RuntimeError(
        "central detection candidate adapter incomplete: "
        f"expected={len(expected)} observed={len(observed)} "
        f"missing={len(missing)} extra={len(extra)} "
        f"error_kinds={json.dumps(error_counts, sort_keys=True)} "
        f"first_errors={json.dumps(first_errors, ensure_ascii=False)}"
    )


def _build_detection_quality_contract(
    *,
    model_path: Path,
    validation_source: Path,
    image_ids: Sequence[str],
    ground_truth_by_image: Mapping[str, Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]],
    image_scale: str,
    letterbox: bool,
    input_hw: Tuple[int, int],
    input_dtype: Any,
    output_format: str,
    output_names: Sequence[str],
    yolo_conf: float,
    yolo_iou: float,
    yolo_max_det: int,
    det_conf: float,
    det_iou: float,
    det_max_det: int,
    labels: Optional[Sequence[str]],
    runner_path: Path,
    endpoint_attestor_sha256: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Freeze the semantic contract used to turn model outputs into records.

    The source endpoint remains explicit.  In particular, a raw YOLO
    ``multiscale_head`` is never renamed to an integrated-NMS endpoint.  The
    separate host adapter is what produces the canonical detection records.
    Model, dataset, preprocessing, decoder implementation and NMS policy are
    independently hashed so a management reference cannot be paired with a
    candidate produced under a different semantic contract.
    """

    model = Path(model_path)
    source = Path(validation_source)
    manifest_path = source / "manifest.json" if source.is_dir() else source
    if not model.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f"quality model artefact is missing: {model}")
    if not manifest_path.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central detection quality requires a frozen validation manifest: "
            f"{manifest_path}"
        )
    runner = Path(runner_path)
    if not runner.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f"quality runner artefact is missing: {runner}")

    ids = sorted(str(value) for value in list(image_ids or []) if str(value))
    if not ids or len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        raise RuntimeError("central detection quality requires unique non-empty Image IDs")
    typed_ids = sorted(f"str:{value}" for value in ids)
    image_ids_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(typed_ids)
    missing_ground_truth = [image_id for image_id in ids if image_id not in ground_truth_by_image]
    if missing_ground_truth:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central detection quality lacks ground truth for: "
            + ", ".join(missing_ground_truth[:5])
        )
    ground_truth_identity = [
        {
            "image_id": image_id,
            "ground_truth": list(ground_truth_by_image.get(image_id) or []),
        }
        for image_id in ids
    ]
    ground_truth_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(ground_truth_identity)
    labels_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256([str(value) for value in list(labels or [])])
    runner_sha256 = _quality_file_sha256(runner)
    attestor_sha256 = str(endpoint_attestor_sha256 or "").strip().lower()
    if (
        len(attestor_sha256) != 64
        or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in attestor_sha256)
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "central detection quality endpoint attestor is invalid"
        )

    preprocess_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/image-preprocessing-contract",
        "schema_version": 2,
        "contract_scope": "prepared_rgb_uint8_semantics",
        "task": "detection",
        "preprocess_mode": "letterbox",
        "spatial_transform": "centered_letterbox",
        "target_hw": [int(input_hw[0]), int(input_hw[1])],
        "color_space": "RGB",
        "input_domain": "uint8_0_255",
        "resize_interpolation": "bilinear",
        "resize_rounding": "python_round_ties_to_even",
        "placement": "floor_top_left_remainder_bottom_right",
        "pad_value": 114,
        "letterbox_pad_value": 114,
        "image_scale": "norm",
        "letterbox": True,
    }
    preprocess_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(preprocess_identity)
    if not bool(letterbox):
        raise RuntimeError("detection quality requires centered letterbox geometry")
    runtime_input_encoding = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/model-input-encoding-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "image_scale": str(image_scale or ""),
        "input_dtype": str(input_dtype or ""),
    }

    source_format = str(output_format or "unknown").strip().lower()
    raw_multiscale = source_format == "multiscale_head"
    decoded_pre_nms = source_format == "ultralytics_decoded"
    decoder_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/detection-decoder-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "adapter_id": "vendored_yolo_harness_with_local_fallback_v1",
        "adapter_location": "quality_record_host_postprocessor",
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha256,
        "source_output_format": source_format,
        "source_output_names": [str(value) for value in list(output_names or [])],
        "source_endpoint_semantics": (
            "raw_multiscale_head" if raw_multiscale else source_format
        ),
        "source_endpoint_has_integrated_nms": (
            False if (raw_multiscale or decoded_pre_nms) else None
        ),
        "canonical_record_endpoint": "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections",
        "confidence_threshold": float(yolo_conf),
        "labels_sha256": labels_sha256,
    }
    decoder_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(decoder_identity)
    nms_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/detection-nms-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "adapter_id": decoder_identity["adapter_id"],
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha256,
        "iou_threshold": float(yolo_iou),
        "max_detections": int(yolo_max_det),
        "detr_or_bn6_confidence_threshold": float(
            det_conf if source_format == "detr_like" else yolo_conf
        ),
        "detr_or_bn6_iou_threshold": float(
            det_iou if source_format == "detr_like" else yolo_iou
        ),
        "detr_or_bn6_max_detections": int(
            det_max_det if source_format == "detr_like" else yolo_max_det
        ),
    }
    nms_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(nms_identity)
    quality_record_endpoint_identity = {
        "schema": (
            "onnx-splitpoint/detection-quality-record-endpoint-contract"
        ),
        "schema_version": 1,
        "canonical_record_endpoint": (
            "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections"
        ),
        "decoder_contract_sha256": decoder_sha256,
        "nms_contract_sha256": nms_sha256,
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha256,
        "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256": attestor_sha256,
    }
    quality_record_endpoint_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(
        quality_record_endpoint_identity
    )

    identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/central-detection-quality-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "task": "detection",
        "model": {
            "artifact_name": model.name,
            "sha256": _quality_file_sha256(model),
        },
        "dataset": {
            "manifest_name": manifest_path.name,
            "manifest_sha256": _portable_dataset_manifest_sha256(
                manifest_path
            ),
            "image_ids_sha256": image_ids_sha256,
            "ground_truth_sha256": ground_truth_sha256,
            "image_count": int(len(ids)),
            "coordinate_space": "original_image_xyxy_pixels",
        },
        "preprocessing": {
            "identity": preprocess_identity,
            "sha256": preprocess_sha256,
            "runtime_input_encoding": runtime_input_encoding,
            "runtime_input_encoding_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(runtime_input_encoding),
        },
        "decoder": {
            "identity": decoder_identity,
            "sha256": decoder_sha256,
        },
        "nms": {
            "identity": nms_identity,
            "sha256": nms_sha256,
        },
        "quality_record_endpoint": {
            "identity": quality_record_endpoint_identity,
            "sha256": quality_record_endpoint_sha256,
        },
        "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": (
            quality_record_endpoint_sha256
        ),
        "source_endpoint_role": "canonical_reference_model_output",
        "source_endpoint_is_raw": bool(raw_multiscale),
        "contract_scope": "canonical_quality_record_semantics",
        "canonical_record_endpoint": "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections",
        "canonical_coordinate_space": "original_image_xyxy_pixels",
    }
    return {**identity, "quality_contract_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(identity)}


def _detection_quality_adapter_mode(
    validation_mode_used: str,
    *,
    cpu_reference_only: bool,
    output_format: str,
) -> str:
    """Select a semantic adapter independently of the fidelity gate mode."""

    if str(validation_mode_used or "").strip().lower() == "proxy_detections":
        return "validation_proxy_detections"
    if cpu_reference_only and str(output_format or "").strip().lower() == "multiscale_head":
        return "canonical_cpu_raw_multiscale_adapter"
    return ""


def _build_native_full_trt_quality_producer_identity(
    *, context: Mapping[str, Any], task: str, variant: str,
    policy: Mapping[str, Any], quality_contract: Mapping[str, Any],
    endpoint_contract: Mapping[str, Any], runtime_precision_identity: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Seal a quality-only request to the exact measured Native Full engine."""

    if str(context.get("execution_role") or "") != "full_quality_only":
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer role is invalid")
    task_l = str(task or "").strip().lower()
    variant_l = str(variant or "").strip().lower()
    if task_l not in {"classification", "detection"} or variant_l != "full":
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer must be a Full task endpoint")
    identity_tokens = (
        "eval_run_id", "model_id", "setup_id", "source_run_id",
        "source_onnx", "build_onnx", "engine",
        "engine_build_receipt_path", "trtexec",
    )
    missing = [name for name in identity_tokens if not str(context.get(name) or "").strip()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer context is incomplete: " + ",".join(missing))

    artifact_fields = {
        "source_onnx": ("source_onnx_sha256", "source_onnx_size_bytes"),
        "build_onnx": ("build_onnx_sha256", "build_onnx_size_bytes"),
        "engine": ("engine_sha256", "engine_size_bytes"),
        "trtexec": ("trtexec_sha256", "trtexec_size_bytes"),
    }
    artifacts: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for artifact_name, (hash_field, size_field) in artifact_fields.items():
        path = Path(str(context.get(artifact_name) or "")).expanduser().resolve()
        declared_hash = str(context.get(hash_field) or "").strip().lower()
        try:
            declared_size = int(context.get(size_field))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"quality-only TRT producer {size_field} is invalid"
            ) from exc
        if (
            not path.is_file()
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", declared_hash)
            or _native_trt_model_sha256(path) != declared_hash
            or int(path.stat().st_size) != declared_size
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"quality-only TRT producer {artifact_name} artifact binding is invalid"
            )
        artifacts[artifact_name] = {
            "path": str(path), "sha256": declared_hash,
            "size_bytes": declared_size,
        }
    if artifacts["source_onnx"]["sha256"] != artifacts["build_onnx"]["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only source ONNX differs from build ONNX")

    receipt = context.get("engine_build_receipt")
    if not isinstance(receipt, Mapping):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer lacks the verified build receipt")
    receipt_identity = dict(receipt)
    receipt_payload = dict(receipt_identity)
    inner_receipt_sha = str(receipt_payload.pop("receipt_sha256", "") or "").strip().lower()
    outer_receipt_sha = _native_trt_canonical_json_sha256(receipt_identity)
    outer_receipt_size = len(_native_trt_canonical_json_bytes(receipt_identity))
    receipt_path = Path(
        str(context.get("engine_build_receipt_path") or "")
    ).expanduser().resolve()
    receipt_file_sha = str(
        context.get("engine_build_receipt_file_sha256") or ""
    ).strip().lower()
    if (
        not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", inner_receipt_sha)
        or _native_trt_canonical_json_sha256(receipt_payload) != inner_receipt_sha
        or outer_receipt_sha
        != str(context.get("engine_build_receipt_sha256") or "").strip().lower()
        or outer_receipt_size != int(context.get("engine_build_receipt_size_bytes") or -1)
        or not receipt_path.is_file()
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", receipt_file_sha)
        or _native_trt_model_sha256(receipt_path) != receipt_file_sha
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer receipt binding is inconsistent")
    expected_receipt_binding = {
        "source_onnx": artifacts["build_onnx"]["path"],
        "source_onnx_sha256": artifacts["build_onnx"]["sha256"],
        "engine": artifacts["engine"]["path"],
        "engine_sha256": artifacts["engine"]["sha256"],
        "trtexec": artifacts["trtexec"]["path"],
        "trtexec_sha256": artifacts["trtexec"]["sha256"],
    }
    if any(str(receipt_identity.get(key) or "") != value for key, value in expected_receipt_binding.items()):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT receipt artifact paths/hashes are inconsistent")
    receipt_command = receipt_identity.get("command")
    command = [str(value) for value in receipt_command] if isinstance(receipt_command, list) else []
    if (
        not command
        or str(Path(command[0]).expanduser().resolve()) != artifacts["trtexec"]["path"]
        or [value for value in command[1:] if value.startswith("--onnx=")]
        != [f"--onnx={artifacts['build_onnx']['path']}"]
        or [value for value in command[1:] if value.startswith("--saveEngine=")]
        != [f"--saveEngine={artifacts['engine']['path']}"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT receipt command is inconsistent")

    quality = dict(quality_contract or {})
    endpoint = dict(endpoint_contract or {})
    quality_sha = str(quality.get("quality_contract_sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    endpoint_hash = str(endpoint.get("endpoint_contract_hash") or "").strip().lower()
    precision_token = str(runtime_precision_identity or "").strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
    policy_sha = str(policy.get("policy_sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    if not all(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value) for value in (quality_sha, endpoint_hash, policy_sha)):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer lacks quality/endpoint/policy hashes")
    if not precision_token:
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT producer lacks runtime precision")
    model_contract = quality.get("model") if isinstance(quality.get("model"), Mapping) else {}
    quality_model_sha = str(
        model_contract.get("sha256") or model_contract.get("source_onnx_sha256") or ""
    ).strip().lower()
    if quality_model_sha != artifacts["source_onnx"]["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT quality contract targets a different source ONNX")
    dataset = quality.get("dataset") if isinstance(quality.get("dataset"), Mapping) else {}
    preprocessing = quality.get("preprocessing") if isinstance(quality.get("preprocessing"), Mapping) else {}
    preprocessing_sha = str(preprocessing.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    if not dataset or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", preprocessing_sha):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT dataset/preprocessing contract is incomplete")

    decoder = quality.get("decoder") if isinstance(quality.get("decoder"), Mapping) else {}
    nms = quality.get("nms") if isinstance(quality.get("nms"), Mapping) else {}
    decoder_sha = str(decoder.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    nms_sha = str(nms.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    if task_l == "detection" and not all(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value) for value in (decoder_sha, nms_sha)
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT detection decoder/NMS contract is incomplete")
    if task_l == "detection":
        preprocess_identity = (
            preprocessing.get("identity")
            if isinstance(preprocessing.get("identity"), Mapping) else {}
        )
        decoder_identity = (
            decoder.get("identity")
            if isinstance(decoder.get("identity"), Mapping) else {}
        )
        nms_identity = (
            nms.get("identity")
            if isinstance(nms.get("identity"), Mapping) else {}
        )
        target_hw = preprocess_identity.get("target_hw")
        source_format = str(
            decoder_identity.get("source_output_format") or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        raw_multiscale = source_format == "multiscale_head"
        semantic_score = (
            decoder_identity.get("confidence_threshold")
            if raw_multiscale else
            nms_identity.get("detr_or_bn6_confidence_threshold")
        )
        semantic_iou = nms_identity.get(
            "iou_threshold" if raw_multiscale
            else "detr_or_bn6_iou_threshold"
        )
        semantic_max = nms_identity.get(
            "max_detections" if raw_multiscale
            else "detr_or_bn6_max_detections"
        )
        if (
            quality.get("task") != "detection"
            or quality.get("canonical_record_endpoint")
            != "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections"
            or decoder_identity.get("canonical_record_endpoint")
            != "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections"
            or not isinstance(target_hw, list)
            or len(target_hw) != 2
            or any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in target_hw)
            or source_format not in {
                "multiscale_head", "ultralytics_decoded", "bn6_detections",
            }
            or quality.get("source_endpoint_is_raw") is not raw_multiscale
            or float(semantic_score or -1.0) != 0.25
            or float(semantic_iou or -1.0) != 0.45
            or isinstance(semantic_max, bool)
            or int(semantic_max or 0) != 300
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "quality-only TRT detection semantics differ from the "
                "canonical completed endpoint"
            )
        try:
            _, canonical_preprocessing_sha = (
                _resolve_image_preprocessing_contract(
                    task="detection",
                    target_hw=(int(target_hw[0]), int(target_hw[1])),
                    declared=preprocess_identity,
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "quality-only TRT detection preprocessing is not canonical"
            ) from exc
        if preprocessing_sha != canonical_preprocessing_sha:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "quality-only TRT detection preprocessing hash is inconsistent"
            )
    runner_sha = _quality_file_sha256(Path(__file__).resolve())
    expected_attestor_sha = str(
        _EXPECTED_VENDORED_ENDPOINT_ATTESTOR_SHA256 or ""
    ).strip().lower()
    attestor_sha = str(_endpoint_attestor_sha256 or "").strip().lower()
    attestor_path = Path(str(_endpoint_attestor_path or "")).expanduser()
    if (
        _endpoint_attestor_source != "suite_vendored"
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_attestor_sha)
        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", attestor_sha)
        or attestor_sha != expected_attestor_sha
        or not attestor_path.is_file()
        or _quality_file_sha256(attestor_path.resolve()) != attestor_sha
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT endpoint attestor bytes do not match the "
            "runner-embedded suite contract"
        )
    endpoint_attestor_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/vendored-endpoint-attestor-identity",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source": "suite_vendored",
        "sha256": attestor_sha,
        "expected_sha256": expected_attestor_sha,
    }
    endpoint_attestor_identity_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(
        endpoint_attestor_identity
    )
    quality_endpoint = quality.get("quality_record_endpoint")
    if not isinstance(quality_endpoint, Mapping):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT quality-record endpoint is missing"
        )
    quality_endpoint = dict(quality_endpoint)
    quality_endpoint_identity = quality_endpoint.get("identity")
    quality_endpoint_sha = str(
        quality_endpoint.get("sha256") or ""
    ).strip().lower()
    if not isinstance(quality_endpoint_identity, Mapping):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT quality-record endpoint identity is missing"
        )
    quality_endpoint_identity = dict(quality_endpoint_identity)
    if task_l == "classification":
        postprocessor = quality.get("postprocessor") if isinstance(quality.get("postprocessor"), Mapping) else {}
        expected_quality_endpoint_identity = {
            "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/classification-quality-record-endpoint-contract",
            "schema_version": 1,
            "canonical_record_endpoint": "classification_topk_hits",
            "postprocessor_contract_sha256": str(postprocessor.get("sha256") or ""),
            "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha,
            "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256": attestor_sha,
        }
    else:
        expected_quality_endpoint_identity = {
            "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/detection-quality-record-endpoint-contract",
            "schema_version": 1,
            "canonical_record_endpoint": "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections",
            "decoder_contract_sha256": decoder_sha,
            "nms_contract_sha256": nms_sha,
            "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha,
            "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256": attestor_sha,
        }
    if (
        quality_endpoint_identity != expected_quality_endpoint_identity
        or _quality_contract_sha256(quality_endpoint_identity)
        != quality_endpoint_sha
        or str(
            quality.get("quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256") or ""
        ).strip().lower() != quality_endpoint_sha
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT quality-record endpoint is inconsistent"
        )
    endpoint_identity = endpoint.get("producer_endpoint_identity")
    if not isinstance(endpoint_identity, Mapping):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT runtime endpoint identity is incomplete")
    endpoint_identity = dict(endpoint_identity)
    endpoint_component_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(endpoint_identity)
    if endpoint_component_sha != endpoint_hash:
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT runtime endpoint hash is inconsistent")
    endpoint_attestation = endpoint.get("output_endpoint_attestation")
    if not isinstance(endpoint_attestation, Mapping):
        raise RuntimeError("quality-only TRT runtime endpoint lacks an attestation")
    endpoint_attestation = dict(endpoint_attestation)
    endpoint_stage = str(endpoint_identity.get("stage") or "").strip().lower()
    expected_endpoint_stage = {
        "multiscale_head": "raw_head",
        "ultralytics_decoded": "decoded_pre_nms",
        "bn6_detections": "decoded_nms",
    }.get(source_format, "") if task_l == "detection" else endpoint_stage
    if task_l == "detection" and endpoint_stage != expected_endpoint_stage:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT detection producer endpoint stage conflicts "
            f"with source format: format={source_format} "
            f"stage={endpoint_stage} expected={expected_endpoint_stage}"
        )
    authority_hash_fields = (
        "source_contracts_sha256", "recorded_contract_sha256",
        "full_model_sha256", "terminal_model_sha256",
    )
    authority_hashes = {
        name: str(endpoint.get(name) or "").strip().lower()
        for name in authority_hash_fields
    }
    if not all(
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value)
        for value in authority_hashes.values()
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT endpoint authority lacks suite-contract hashes"
        )
    if authority_hashes["source_contracts_sha256"] == authority_hashes[
        "recorded_contract_sha256"
    ]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT endpoint authority collapses container and row hashes"
        )
    if any(
        authority_hashes[name] != artifacts["source_onnx"]["sha256"]
        for name in ("full_model_sha256", "terminal_model_sha256")
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT endpoint authority targets a different Full graph"
        )
    if (
        str(endpoint.get("graph_binding_source") or "")
        != "authoritative_suite_output_contract_plus_exact_onnx_endpoint:v2"
        or str(endpoint.get("contract_resolution_status") or "") != "attested"
        or endpoint.get("endpoint_contract_complete") is not True
        or endpoint_attestation.get("attested") is not True
        or str(endpoint_attestation.get("status") or "") != "passed"
        or str(endpoint_attestation.get("stage") or "").strip().lower()
        != endpoint_stage
        or str(endpoint_attestation.get("endpoint_contract_hash") or "")
        .strip().lower() != endpoint_component_sha
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "quality-only TRT endpoint authority is incomplete or inconsistent"
        )
    endpoint_authority_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/tensorrt-endpoint-authority",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "graph_binding_source": str(endpoint["graph_binding_source"]),
        **authority_hashes,
        "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_component_sha,
        "endpoint_contract_complete": True,
        "contract_resolution_status": "attested",
        "stage": endpoint_stage,
        "output_endpoint_attestation": endpoint_attestation,
    }
    endpoint_authority_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(
        endpoint_authority_identity
    )
    precision_identity = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/tensorrt-runtime-precision-contract",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "runtime_precision_identity": precision_token,
        "source_onnx_sha256": artifacts["source_onnx"]["sha256"],
        "build_onnx_sha256": artifacts["build_onnx"]["sha256"],
        "engine_sha256": artifacts["engine"]["sha256"],
    }
    precision_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(precision_identity)
    source_onnx = dict(artifacts["source_onnx"])
    build_onnx = {
        **artifacts["build_onnx"],
        "source_onnx_sha256": source_onnx["sha256"],
    }
    engine = {
        **artifacts["engine"],
        "source_onnx_sha256": source_onnx["sha256"],
        "build_onnx_sha256": build_onnx["sha256"],
    }
    engine_build_receipt = {
        "path": str(receipt_path),
        "sha256": outer_receipt_sha,
        "size_bytes": outer_receipt_size,
        "receipt": receipt_identity,
    }
    producer: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/tensorrt-central-quality-producer-identity",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "eval_run_id": str(context["eval_run_id"]),
        "model_id": str(context["model_id"]),
        "setup_id": str(context["setup_id"]),
        "source_run_id": str(context["source_run_id"]),
        "originating_plan_run_id": str(
            context.get("originating_plan_run_id") or ""
        ),
        "case_id": "full",
        "execution_role": "full_quality_only",
        "backend": "native_tensorrt",
        "variant": "full",
        "task": task_l,
        "source_onnx": source_onnx,
        "build_onnx": build_onnx,
        "engine": engine,
        "trtexec": dict(artifacts["trtexec"]),
        "engine_build_receipt": engine_build_receipt,
        "engine_build_receipt_file_sha256": str(
            receipt_file_sha
        ),
        "model": {
            "source_onnx_sha256": source_onnx["sha256"],
            "source_onnx_size_bytes": source_onnx["size_bytes"],
            "build_onnx_sha256": build_onnx["sha256"],
            "build_onnx_size_bytes": build_onnx["size_bytes"],
            "runtime_artifact_sha256": engine["sha256"],
            "runtime_artifact_size_bytes": engine["size_bytes"],
        },
        "dataset": dict(dataset),
        "preprocessing": dict(preprocessing),
        "endpoint": {"identity": endpoint_identity, "sha256": endpoint_component_sha},
        "endpoint_authority": {
            "identity": endpoint_authority_identity,
            "sha256": endpoint_authority_sha,
        },
        "quality_record_endpoint": {
            "identity": quality_endpoint_identity, "sha256": quality_endpoint_sha,
        },
        "endpoint_attestor": {
            "identity": endpoint_attestor_identity,
            "sha256": endpoint_attestor_identity_sha,
            "path": str(attestor_path.resolve()),
        },
        "precision": {"identity": precision_identity, "sha256": precision_sha},
        "quality_contract": quality,
        "quality_contract_sha256": quality_sha,
        "preprocessing_contract_sha256": preprocessing_sha,
        "decoder_contract_sha256": decoder_sha,
        "nms_contract_sha256": nms_sha,
        "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
        "endpoint_contract_complete": True,
        "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": quality_endpoint_sha,
        "runtime_precision_identity": precision_token,
        "policy_sha256": policy_sha,
        "implementation_runner_sha256": runner_sha,
        "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256": attestor_sha,
        "performance_claims_emitted": False,
    }
    producer_sha = _quality_contract_sha256(producer)
    return {**producer, "producer_identity_sha256": producer_sha}


def _export_central_quality_inputs(
    *,
    out_dir: Path,
    task: str,
    variant: str,
    policy: Dict[str, Any],
    classification_rows: Optional[Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    gt_by_image: Optional[Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
    candidate_by_image: Optional[Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
    reference_by_image: Optional[Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]] = None,
    quality_contract: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    endpoint_contract: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    runtime_precision_identity: str = "",
    producer_context: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    full_only_quality_identity: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    native_split_quality_binding: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    composed_producer_context: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    candidate_completion_contract: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    completed_task_evidence: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    diagnostics: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Export GT/candidates remotely or the CPU reference on management only.

    In normal ``central_management`` runs an accelerator host must never create
    a canonical CPU prediction.  It emits a portable candidate artifact plus a
    descriptor containing the exact expected Image IDs.  The descriptor has no
    path by design and can only be resolved by explicitly supplying the
    management-side reference artifact.  ``ONNX_SPLITPOINT_CPU_REFERENCE_ONLY``
    is the sole mode allowed to write ``canonical_*_reference.json``.
    """
    import os as _os

    execution_location = _task_quality_execution_location(policy)
    if execution_location != "central_management":
        if diagnostics is not None:
            diagnostics["export"] = {
                "status": "not_requested",
                "reason": "quality_execution_location_not_central_management",
                "execution_location": execution_location,
            }
        return {}
    task_l = str(task or "").strip().lower()
    variant_l = str(variant or "unknown").strip().lower()
    if variant_l not in {"full", "composed"}:
        if diagnostics is not None:
            diagnostics["export"] = {
                "status": "not_requested",
                "reason": "variant_not_central_quality_candidate",
                "variant": variant_l,
            }
        return {}
    quality_payload = dict(quality_contract or {})
    if quality_payload and producer_context is None:
        live_attestor_sha256 = (
            _verified_suite_vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256()
        )
        quality_endpoint = quality_payload.get("quality_record_endpoint")
        quality_endpoint = (
            dict(quality_endpoint)
            if isinstance(quality_endpoint, Mapping) else {}
        )
        quality_endpoint_identity = quality_endpoint.get("identity")
        quality_endpoint_identity = (
            dict(quality_endpoint_identity)
            if isinstance(quality_endpoint_identity, Mapping) else {}
        )
        if str(
            quality_endpoint_identity.get(
                "vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256"
            ) or ""
        ).strip().lower() != live_attestor_sha256:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "central quality contract endpoint attestor differs from "
                "the live suite-vendored attestor"
            )
    reference_only = str(_os.environ.get("ONNX_SPLITPOINT_CPU_REFERENCE_ONLY", "")).strip().lower() in {
        "1", "true", "yes", "on"
    }
    endpoint = dict(endpoint_contract or {})
    endpoint_hash = str(endpoint.get("endpoint_contract_hash") or "").strip().lower()
    precision_identity = str(runtime_precision_identity or "").strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
    endpoint_complete = bool(
        endpoint.get("endpoint_contract_complete") is True
        and len(endpoint_hash) == 64
        and all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in endpoint_hash)
    )
    # A central task-quality decision may be attached to a measured producer
    # only when the exact logical output endpoint and runtime precision are
    # known.  Do not emit an unbound request that can later be joined merely by
    # model/case/backend similarity.
    if not reference_only and (not endpoint_complete or not precision_identity):
        if diagnostics is not None:
            attestation = (
                dict(endpoint.get("output_endpoint_attestation") or {})
                if isinstance(endpoint.get("output_endpoint_attestation"), Mapping)
                else {}
            )
            diagnostics["export"] = {
                "status": "failed_closed",
                "reason": (
                    "endpoint_contract_incomplete_and_runtime_precision_missing"
                    if not endpoint_complete and not precision_identity
                    else "endpoint_contract_incomplete"
                    if not endpoint_complete
                    else "runtime_precision_identity_missing"
                ),
                "endpoint_contract_complete": endpoint_complete,
                "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
                "endpoint_stage": str(endpoint.get("stage") or ""),
                "endpoint_attestation_reason": str(
                    attestation.get("reason") or ""
                ),
                "runtime_precision_identity": precision_identity,
            }
        return {}
    completed_task_duplicates: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if completed_task_evidence is not None:
        if task_l != "detection" or variant_l != "full":
            raise RuntimeError(
                "completed-task quality binding requires detection/full"
            )
        evidence = dict(completed_task_evidence)
        try:
            try:
                from splitpoint_runners.native_detection_postprocess import (
                    verify_completed_detection_comparison_endpoint_contract,
                )
            except ModuleNotFoundError:
                from onnx_splitpoint_tool.native_detection_postprocess import (
                    verify_completed_detection_comparison_endpoint_contract,
                )
            completed_contract = (
                verify_completed_detection_comparison_endpoint_contract(
                    evidence.get(
                        "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract"
                    )
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "completed-task quality endpoint contract invalid"
            ) from exc
        completed_hash = str(
            completed_contract.get("endpoint_contract_hash") or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        completed_output_id = str(
            completed_contract.get("output_endpoint_id") or ""
        )
        completed_attestation = evidence.get(
            "completed_task_endpoint_attestation"
        )
        if (
            str(
                evidence.get(
                    "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract_hash"
                ) or ""
            ).strip().lower() != completed_hash
            or str(
                evidence.get(
                    "completed_task_comparison_output_endpoint_id"
                ) or ""
            ) != completed_output_id
            or not isinstance(completed_attestation, Mapping)
            or completed_attestation.get("attested") is not True
            or str(
                completed_attestation.get("status") or ""
            ).strip().lower() != "passed"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "completed-task quality endpoint attestation invalid"
            )
        completed_task_duplicates = {
            "completed_task_endpoint_contract": completed_contract,
            "completed_task_endpoint_contract_hash": completed_hash,
            "completed_task_output_endpoint_id": completed_output_id,
            "completed_task_endpoint_attestation": dict(
                completed_attestation
            ),
            "completed_task_endpoint_attestation_sha256": (
                _quality_contract_sha256(completed_attestation)
            ),
            "quality_join_endpoint": "completed_task_decoded_nms",
        }
    base = out_dir / "task_quality_inputs"
    reference_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    candidate_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if task_l == "classification":
        for row in sorted(list(classification_rows or []), key=lambda item: str(item.get("image") or item.get("image_id") or "")):
            image_id = str(row.get("image_id") or row.get("image") or "").strip()
            if not image_id:
                continue
            reference_records.append({
                "image_id": image_id,
                "label_id": row.get("label_id"),
                "label_name": row.get("label_name"),
                "reference": row.get("gt_reference") if isinstance(row.get("gt_reference"), dict) else {},
            })
            candidate_records.append({
                "image_id": image_id,
                "label_id": row.get("label_id"),
                "label_name": row.get("label_name"),
                "candidate": row.get("gt") if isinstance(row.get("gt"), dict) else {},
            })
    else:
        gt_map = gt_by_image or {}
        cand_map = candidate_by_image or {}
        ref_map = reference_by_image or {}
        image_ids = sorted(set(gt_map) & set(cand_map))
        for image_id in image_ids:
            if image_id in ref_map:
                reference_records.append({
                    "image_id": str(image_id),
                    "ground_truth": list(gt_map.get(image_id) or []),
                    "reference": list(ref_map.get(image_id) or []),
                })
            candidate_records.append({
                "image_id": str(image_id),
                "ground_truth": list(gt_map.get(image_id) or []),
                "candidate": list(cand_map.get(image_id) or []),
            })

    producer_identity: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    producer_duplicates: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if producer_context is not None:
        try:
            producer_identity = _build_native_full_trt_quality_producer_identity(
                context=producer_context,
                task=task_l,
                variant=variant_l,
                policy=policy,
                quality_contract=dict(quality_contract or {}),
                endpoint_contract=endpoint,
                runtime_precision_identity=precision_identity,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            if diagnostics is not None:
                diagnostics["producer_identity"] = {
                    "status": "failed_closed",
                    "reason": "native_full_tensorrt_producer_identity_invalid",
                    "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                }
            raise
        if diagnostics is not None:
            diagnostics["producer_identity"] = {
                "status": "attested",
                "reason": "native_full_tensorrt_producer_identity_verified",
                "producer_identity_sha256": str(
                    producer_identity.get("producer_identity_sha256") or ""
                ),
            }
        source_onnx = producer_identity["source_onnx"]
        build_onnx = producer_identity["build_onnx"]
        engine = producer_identity["engine"]
        trtexec = producer_identity["trtexec"]
        receipt_binding = producer_identity["engine_build_receipt"]
        receipt = receipt_binding["receipt"]
        producer_duplicates = {
            "producer_provenance_required": True,
            "producer_identity": producer_identity,
            "producer_identity_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["producer_identity_sha256"]
            ),
            "preprocessing_contract_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["preprocessing_contract_sha256"]
            ),
            "decoder_contract_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["decoder_contract_sha256"]
            ),
            "nms_contract_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["nms_contract_sha256"]
            ),
            "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256"]
            ),
            "eval_run_id": str(producer_identity["eval_run_id"]),
            "model_id": str(producer_identity["model_id"]),
            "setup_id": str(producer_identity["setup_id"]),
            "source_run_id": str(producer_identity["source_run_id"]),
            "case_id": "full",
            "execution_role": str(producer_identity["execution_role"]),
            "backend": str(producer_identity["backend"]),
            "performance_claims_emitted": False,
            "source_model_sha256": str(source_onnx["sha256"]),
            "build_onnx_sha256": str(build_onnx["sha256"]),
            "runtime_artifact_sha256": str(engine["sha256"]),
            "trtexec_sha256": str(trtexec["sha256"]),
            "engine_build_receipt_sha256": str(receipt_binding["sha256"]),
            "engine_build_receipt_file_sha256": str(
                producer_identity["engine_build_receipt_file_sha256"]
            ),
            "trt_engine_build_receipt_sha256": str(receipt["receipt_sha256"]),
        }

    # Vendor Full-only runs do not have the Native TensorRT producer receipt,
    # but they are still governed by the exact pre-hardware canary identity.
    # Materialize that sealed identity in both portable artifacts before the
    # candidate descriptor is hashed and before either file is copied off the
    # hardware host.  Missing values are not inferred from directory names.
    full_only_duplicates: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if full_only_quality_identity is not None:
        if not isinstance(full_only_quality_identity, Mapping):
            raise RuntimeError("Full-only quality identity must be an object")
        full_only_identity = dict(full_only_quality_identity)
        allowed_full_only_fields = {
            "schema", "schema_version", "quality_canary_id", "eval_run_id",
            "model_id", "setup_id", "source_run_id", "backend", "variant",
            "execution_role", "performance_claims_emitted",
        }
        unknown_full_only_fields = sorted(
            set(full_only_identity) - allowed_full_only_fields
        )
        required_full_only_text = (
            "quality_canary_id", "eval_run_id", "model_id", "setup_id",
            "source_run_id", "backend", "variant", "execution_role",
        )
        invalid_full_only_fields = [
            field_name for field_name in required_full_only_text
            if not str(full_only_identity.get(field_name) or "").strip()
        ]
        if (
            unknown_full_only_fields
            or str(full_only_identity.get("schema") or "")
            != "onnx-splitpoint/full-only-quality-request-identity"
            or type(full_only_identity.get("schema_version")) is not int
            or full_only_identity.get("schema_version") != 1
            or str(full_only_identity.get("variant") or "").strip().lower()
            != "full"
            or str(
                full_only_identity.get("execution_role") or ""
            ).strip().lower() != "full_quality_only"
            or full_only_identity.get("performance_claims_emitted") is not False
            or invalid_full_only_fields
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Full-only quality identity is not an exact sealed "
                "non-performance Full identity"
            )
        canonical_full_only_identity = {
            "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/full-only-quality-request-identity",
            "schema_version": 1,
            "quality_canary_id": str(
                full_only_identity["quality_canary_id"]
            ).strip(),
            "eval_run_id": str(full_only_identity["eval_run_id"]).strip(),
            "model_id": str(full_only_identity["model_id"]).strip(),
            "setup_id": str(full_only_identity["setup_id"]).strip(),
            "source_run_id": str(
                full_only_identity["source_run_id"]
            ).strip(),
            "backend": str(full_only_identity["backend"]).strip().lower(),
            "variant": "full",
            "execution_role": "full_quality_only",
            "performance_claims_emitted": False,
        }
        full_only_identity_sha256 = _quality_contract_sha256(
            canonical_full_only_identity
        )
        full_only_duplicates = {
            "full_only_plan_identity_required": True,
            "full_only_plan_identity": canonical_full_only_identity,
            "full_only_plan_identity_sha256": full_only_identity_sha256,
            "quality_canary_id": canonical_full_only_identity[
                "quality_canary_id"
            ],
            "eval_run_id": canonical_full_only_identity["eval_run_id"],
            "model_id": canonical_full_only_identity["model_id"],
            "setup_id": canonical_full_only_identity["setup_id"],
            "source_run_id": canonical_full_only_identity["source_run_id"],
            # The Full-only plan names TensorRT logically as ``tensorrt``,
            # while the signed runtime producer is physically identified as
            # ``native_tensorrt``.  Top-level producer duplicates must remain
            # byte-for-byte equal to the signed producer for the strict
            # management-side integrity check.  The logical backend remains
            # sealed inside ``full_only_plan_identity`` and is canonicalised
            # by the workflow join after the producer has been validated.
            "backend": (
                str(producer_identity["backend"])
                if producer_identity
                else canonical_full_only_identity["backend"]
            ),
            "variant": "full",
            "execution_role": "full_quality_only",
            "performance_claims_emitted": False,
        }

    split_duplicates: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if native_split_quality_binding is not None:
        if variant_l != "composed":
            raise RuntimeError(
                "native split Quality-FIRST binding is valid only for composed candidates"
            )
        split_binding = dict(native_split_quality_binding)
        split_selection = split_binding.get("preselection")
        split_selection = (
            dict(split_selection) if isinstance(split_selection, Mapping) else {}
        )
        split_binding_sha = str(split_binding.get("binding_sha256") or "").strip().lower()
        if (
            not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", split_binding_sha)
            or str(split_selection.get("precision") or "").strip().lower()
            != precision_identity
            or str(split_binding.get("eval_run_id") or "").strip() == ""
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "native split Quality-FIRST binding precision/identity mismatch"
            )
        split_duplicates = {
            "native_split_quality_binding_required": True,
            "native_split_quality_binding": split_binding,
            "native_split_quality_binding_sha256": split_binding_sha,
            "eval_run_id": str(split_binding.get("eval_run_id") or ""),
            "model_id": str(split_selection.get("model_id") or ""),
            "case_id": str(split_selection.get("case_id") or ""),
            "setup_id": str(split_selection.get("setup_id") or ""),
            "source_run_id": str(split_binding.get("source_run_id") or ""),
            "backend": str(split_selection.get("backend") or ""),
            "performance_claims_emitted": False,
        }

    reference_payload = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/task-quality-reference-input",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "task": task_l,
        "pairing_key": "image_id",
        "reference_role": "canonical_cpu_ort",
        "semantic_reference_only": True,
        "provenance_required": bool(quality_contract),
        "quality_contract": dict(quality_contract or {}),
        "quality_contract_sha256": str((quality_contract or {}).get("quality_contract_sha256") or ""),
        "records": reference_records,
    }
    if reference_only:
        # The management reference job executes only the full variant.  It
        # deliberately emits no evaluation request and no accelerator metric.
        _write_stable_quality_json(base / f"canonical_{task_l}_reference.json", reference_payload)
        if diagnostics is not None:
            diagnostics["export"] = {
                "status": "reference_written",
                "reason": "management_cpu_reference_only",
                "record_count": int(len(reference_records)),
            }
        return {}

    completion_contract = dict(candidate_completion_contract or {})
    completion_contract_sha = ""
    if completion_contract:
        completion_contract_sha = str(
            completion_contract.pop("contract_sha256", "") or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        if (
            not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", completion_contract_sha)
            or _quality_contract_sha256(completion_contract)
            != completion_contract_sha
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("candidate execution completion contract hash mismatch")
        completion_contract["contract_sha256"] = completion_contract_sha

    generic_composed_duplicates: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant_l == "composed" and native_split_quality_binding is None:
        if composed_producer_context is None:
            if diagnostics is not None:
                diagnostics["producer_identity"] = {
                    "status": "legacy_unbound",
                    "reason": "generic_composed_producer_context_not_supplied",
                }
            # Compatibility for historical/direct analysis helpers.  Active
            # v2.79.11 workflow invocations always provide the context; the
            # management identity verifier marks legacy-unbound envelopes
            # non-claimable.
        else:
            generic_producer, completion_contract = (
                _build_generic_composed_quality_producer_binding(
                    context=composed_producer_context,
                    task=task_l,
                    quality_contract=dict(quality_contract or {}),
                    endpoint_contract=endpoint,
                    runtime_precision_identity=precision_identity,
                    candidate_completion_contract=completion_contract,
                )
            )
            completion_contract_sha = str(
                completion_contract.get("contract_sha256") or ""
            ).strip().lower()
            generic_composed_duplicates = {
                "artifact_provenance_contract_version": 1,
                "producer_provenance_required": True,
                "producer_identity": generic_producer,
                "producer_identity_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["producer_identity_sha256"]
                ),
                "eval_run_id": str(generic_producer["eval_run_id"]),
                "model_id": str(generic_producer["model_id"]),
                "setup_id": str(generic_producer["setup_id"]),
                "source_run_id": str(generic_producer["source_run_id"]),
                "case_id": str(generic_producer["case_id"]),
                "backend": str(generic_producer["backend"]),
                "execution_role": str(generic_producer["execution_role"]),
                "performance_claims_emitted": False,
                "source_model_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["model"]["source_onnx_sha256"]
                ),
                "part1_model_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["model"]["part1_onnx_sha256"]
                ),
                "part2_model_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["model"]["part2_onnx_sha256"]
                ),
                "runtime_artifact_set_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["runtime_artifact_set_sha256"]
                ),
                # The central Quality contract requires the producer's
                # preprocessing identity both inside ``producer_identity``
                # and as a duplicated request/candidate field.  The producer
                # already contains this established digest; carry it forward
                # instead of inventing a new identity or hash layer.
                "preprocessing_contract_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["preprocessing_contract_sha256"]
                ),
                "decoder_contract_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["decoder_contract_sha256"]
                ),
                "nms_contract_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer["nms_contract_sha256"]
                ),
                "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256": str(
                    generic_producer[
                        "quality_record_endpoint_contract_sha256"
                    ]
                ),
            }
            if diagnostics is not None:
                diagnostics["producer_identity"] = {
                    "status": "attested",
                    "reason": "generic_composed_producer_identity_verified",
                    "producer_identity_sha256": str(
                        generic_producer["producer_identity_sha256"]
                    ),
                    "runtime_artifact_set_sha256": str(
                        generic_producer["runtime_artifact_set_sha256"]
                    ),
                }
    candidate_payload = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/task-quality-candidate-input",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "task": task_l,
        "variant": variant_l,
        "pairing_key": "image_id",
        "provenance_required": bool(quality_contract),
        "quality_contract": dict(quality_contract or {}),
        "quality_contract_sha256": str((quality_contract or {}).get("quality_contract_sha256") or ""),
        "endpoint_contract": endpoint,
        "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
        "runtime_precision_identity": precision_identity,
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract": completion_contract,
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract_sha256": completion_contract_sha,
        **completed_task_duplicates,
        **producer_duplicates,
        **split_duplicates,
        **full_only_duplicates,
        **generic_composed_duplicates,
        "record_count": int(len(candidate_records)),
        "records": candidate_records,
    }
    candidate_file = _write_stable_quality_json(base / f"{variant_l}_candidate.json", candidate_payload)
    candidate_file["path"] = Path(str(candidate_file.get("path") or "")).name
    expected_image_ids = [record["image_id"] for record in candidate_records]
    typed_ids = sorted(f"str:{image_id}" for image_id in expected_image_ids)
    expected_ids_encoded = json.dumps(typed_ids, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    expected_ids_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(expected_ids_encoded).hexdigest()
    reference_descriptor = {
        "source": "management_cpu_reference",
        "reference_role": "canonical_cpu_ort",
        "semantic_reference_only": True,
        "required": True,
        "expected_image_ids": expected_image_ids,
        "expected_image_ids_sha256": expected_ids_sha256,
        "record_count": int(len(expected_image_ids)),
        "quality_contract_sha256": str((quality_contract or {}).get("quality_contract_sha256") or ""),
    }
    stats = policy.get("statistics") if isinstance(policy.get("statistics"), dict) else {}
    metric_gate = dict(policy.get(task_l) or {})
    if policy.get("reporting_policy"):
        metric_gate["reporting_policy"] = dict(policy["reporting_policy"])
    request_payload = {
        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/central-quality-evaluation-request",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "status": "pending_central_evaluation",
        "task": task_l,
        "variant": variant_l,
        "pairing_key": "image_id",
        "execution_location": "management_node",
        "requested_by": "central_management",
        "reference": reference_descriptor,
        "candidate": candidate_file,
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract": completion_contract,
        "candidate_execution_completion_contract_sha256": completion_contract_sha,
        **completed_task_duplicates,
        "record_count": int(len(candidate_records)),
        "reference_record_count": int(len(candidate_records)),
        "expected_image_ids": expected_image_ids,
        "expected_image_ids_sha256": expected_ids_sha256,
        "provenance_required": bool(quality_contract),
        "quality_contract": dict(quality_contract or {}),
        "quality_contract_sha256": str((quality_contract or {}).get("quality_contract_sha256") or ""),
        "endpoint_contract": endpoint,
        "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
        "runtime_precision_identity": precision_identity,
        **producer_duplicates,
        **split_duplicates,
        **full_only_duplicates,
        **generic_composed_duplicates,
        "policy_sha256": str(policy.get("policy_sha256") or ""),
        "metric_gate_config": metric_gate,
        "statistics": {
            "method": str(stats.get("method") or "paired_bootstrap"),
            "bootstrap_repetitions": int(stats.get("bootstrap_repetitions") or 500),
            "seed": int(stats.get("seed") or 20260710),
            "confidence_level": float(stats.get("confidence_level") or 0.95),
            "decision": str(stats.get("decision") or "lower_one_sided_bound"),
        },
    }
    request_file = _write_stable_quality_json(base / f"{variant_l}_request.json", request_payload)
    request_file["path"] = str(Path(str(request_file.get("path") or "")).resolve())
    if diagnostics is not None:
        diagnostics["export"] = {
            "status": "emitted",
            "reason": "central_quality_request_written",
            "record_count": int(len(candidate_records)),
            "request_path": str(request_file.get("path") or ""),
            "endpoint_contract_hash": endpoint_hash,
            "runtime_precision_identity": precision_identity,
        }
    return {**request_payload, "request": request_file}


def _central_quality_endpoint_contract(
    *, task: str, output_names: Sequence[str], outputs: Sequence[np.ndarray],
    detected_output_format: str,
    declared_endpoint_contract: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    diagnostics: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Attest the exact pre-quality-adapter runtime endpoint, fail closed."""
    def _fail(reason: str, **details: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if diagnostics is not None:
            diagnostics["runtime_endpoint"] = {
                "status": "failed",
                "reason": str(reason),
                **details,
            }
        return {}

    if runtime_output_contract is None:
        return _fail(
            "runtime_output_contract_unavailable",
            import_error=str(_runtime_output_contract_import_error or ""),
        )
    output_map = {
        str(name): np.asarray(value)
        for name, value in zip(list(output_names or []), list(outputs or []))
    }
    task_l = str(task or "").strip().lower()
    fmt = str(detected_output_format or "").strip().lower()
    declared: Dict[str, Any]
    if task_l == "classification":
        recorded_stage = str(
            (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("stage")
            or (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("contract_family")
            or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        if recorded_stage not in {
            "classification_logits", "classification_probabilities",
        }:
            return _fail(
                "classification_authoritative_stage_missing_or_unsupported",
                recorded_stage=recorded_stage,
            )
        declared = dict(declared_endpoint_contract or {})
    elif fmt in {"bn6_detections", "decoded_nms"}:
        # A [B,N,6] value layout alone does not prove that NMS was executed.
        # Require producer/export binding metadata naming NMS *or* a recorded
        # suite declaration which has already been bound to the exact executed
        # ONNX endpoint by ``_recorded_suite_endpoint_declaration``.
        recorded_stage = str(
            (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("stage")
            or (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("contract_family")
            or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        if recorded_stage == "decoded_nms":
            declared = dict(declared_endpoint_contract or {})
        elif any(
            token in str(name).strip().lower()
            for name in output_map
            for token in ("nms", "non_max", "nonmax", "batchednms", "efficientnms")
        ):
            declared = {"stage": "decoded_nms"}
        else:
            return _fail(
                "decoded_nms_authoritative_declaration_missing",
                detected_output_format=fmt,
                recorded_stage=recorded_stage,
                runtime_output_names=[str(name) for name in output_map],
            )
    elif fmt == "ultralytics_decoded":
        recorded_stage = str(
            (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("stage")
            or (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("contract_family")
            or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        if recorded_stage != "decoded_pre_nms":
            return _fail(
                "decoded_pre_nms_authoritative_declaration_missing",
                detected_output_format=fmt,
                recorded_stage=recorded_stage,
                runtime_output_names=[str(name) for name in output_map],
            )
        declared = dict(declared_endpoint_contract or {})
    elif fmt in {
        "multiscale_head", "ultralytics_regcls", "concat", "detr_like",
        "raw_head", "raw_detection_tensors",
    }:
        # This declaration describes only the measured producer endpoint.  The
        # separately hashed decoder/NMS quality contract describes conversion
        # to canonical per-image detection records.
        recorded_stage = str(
            (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("stage")
            or (declared_endpoint_contract or {}).get("contract_family")
            or ""
        ).strip().lower()
        if recorded_stage not in {"raw_head", "decoded_pre_nms"}:
            return _fail(
                "raw_detection_authoritative_stage_missing_or_unsupported",
                detected_output_format=fmt,
                recorded_stage=recorded_stage,
            )
        declared = dict(declared_endpoint_contract or {})
    else:
        return _fail(
            "detected_output_format_not_endpoint_attestable",
