                    f"[validation][mini-classification] {v}: top1={mini_payload.get('top1_accuracy')} top5={mini_payload.get('top5_accuracy')} images={mini_payload.get('images')} labeled={mini_payload.get('labeled_images')}"
                )
            quality_gate_variant = _classification_task_quality_gate(per_image_rows, v, task_quality_policy)
            _quality_output_names = list(variant_output_names.get(v) or output_names)
            _quality_outputs = list(variant_outputs.get(v) or [])
            _quality_terminal_model = (
                full_path if str(v).strip().lower() == "full" else p2_path
            )
            _quality_export_diagnostics: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            _quality_endpoint_declaration = _recorded_suite_endpoint_declaration(
                base_dir=base_dir,
                full_model=full_path,
                terminal_model=_quality_terminal_model,
                variant=str(v),
                provider=(
                    str(full_tok or "")
                    if str(v).strip().lower() == "full"
                    else str(stage2_tok or "")
                ),
                task="classification",
                output_names=_quality_output_names,
                outputs=_quality_outputs,
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            _quality_endpoint = _central_quality_endpoint_contract(
                task="classification",
                output_names=_quality_output_names,
                outputs=_quality_outputs,
                detected_output_format=_detect_output_format(
                    _quality_output_names, _quality_outputs,
                ) if _quality_outputs else "unknown",
                declared_endpoint_contract=_quality_endpoint_declaration,
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            _quality_precision = _central_quality_runtime_precision_identity(
                variant=v, full_provider=str(full_tok or ""),
                stage1_provider=str(stage1_tok or ""),
                stage2_provider=str(stage2_tok or ""),
                boundary_mode=str(_boundary_mode or "canonical_float32"),
                trt_precision=str(getattr(args, "native_trt_precision", "fp16") or "fp16"),
                full_artifact_path=str(hef_full or "") if 'hef_full' in locals() else "",
            )
            _classification_quality_contract = None
            if _task_quality_execution_location(task_quality_policy) == "central_management":
                if _validation_source_path is None:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "central classification quality requires an explicit validation source"
                    )
                _classification_quality_contract = _build_classification_quality_contract(
                    model_path=full_path,
                    validation_source=_validation_source_path,
                    rows=per_image_rows,
                    image_scale=str(resolved_image_scale or "imagenet"),
                    letterbox=classification_validation_letterbox,
                    input_hw=(int((img_hw or (224, 224))[0]), int((img_hw or (224, 224))[1])),
                    input_dtype=image_input_dtype,
                    runner_path=Path(__file__).resolve(),
                    endpoint_attestor_sha256=(
                        _verified_suite_vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256()
                    ),
                )
            quality_input_request = _export_central_quality_inputs(
                out_dir=out_dir,
                task="classification",
                variant=v,
                policy=task_quality_policy,
                classification_rows=per_image_rows,
                quality_contract=_classification_quality_contract,
                endpoint_contract=_quality_endpoint,
                runtime_precision_identity=_quality_precision,
                producer_context=getattr(
                    args, "_quality_evidence_producer_context", None,
                ),
                full_only_quality_identity=getattr(
                    args, "_full_only_quality_identity_context", None,
                ),
                native_split_quality_binding=getattr(
                    args, "_native_split_quality_binding", None,
                ),
                composed_producer_context=(
                    _active_composed_quality_producer_context()
                    if str(v).strip().lower() == "composed"
                    and not cpu_reference_only_mode
                    and not isinstance(
                        getattr(
                            args, "_native_split_quality_binding", None,
                        ), Mapping,
                    )
                    else None
                ),
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            task_quality_input_export_diagnostics_by_variant[v] = dict(
                _quality_export_diagnostics
            )
            if quality_input_request:
                quality_gate_variant["quality_input_request"] = quality_input_request
                task_quality_input_requests_by_variant[v] = quality_input_request
            elif (
                _task_quality_execution_location(task_quality_policy) == "central_management"
                and not cpu_reference_only_mode
                and str(v).strip().lower() in {"full", "composed"}
            ):
                # Never advertise a pending central decision unless a concrete,
                # content-addressed request was emitted.  In 2.69c a missing
                # endpoint helper left 42 rows pending while the request map was
                # empty, hiding the real export failure.
                quality_gate_variant.update({
                    "decision": "unavailable",
                    "status": "unavailable",
                    "reason": "central_quality_request_not_emitted",
                    "quality_input_export_status": "failed_closed",
                    "quality_input_export_diagnostics": dict(
                        _quality_export_diagnostics
                    ),
                })
                print(
                    "[central-quality-export][blocked] "
                    f"variant={v} task=classification diagnostics="
                    f"{json.dumps(_quality_export_diagnostics, sort_keys=True)}",
                    flush=True,
                )
            task_quality_gate_by_variant[v] = quality_gate_variant
            comparisons[v]["task_quality_gate"] = quality_gate_variant
            print(
                f"[quality-gate] {v}: tier={quality_gate_variant.get('tier')} decision={quality_gate_variant.get('decision')} "
                f"metric={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('metric')} delta={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('delta')} "
                f"lcb={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('ci_low')} margin={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('margin')}"
            )

        primary_sem = proxy_dataset_by_variant.get(primary_variant) if primary_variant is not None else None
        semantic_validation_pass = (
            bool(primary_sem.get("pass"))
            if isinstance(primary_sem, dict) and primary_sem.get("pass") is not None
            else None
        )
        semantic_validation_pass_all = None
        if proxy_dataset_by_variant:
            known_semantic_passes = [
                bool(payload.get("pass"))
                for payload in proxy_dataset_by_variant.values()
                if payload.get("pass") is not None
            ]
            semantic_validation_pass_all = (
                all(known_semantic_passes) if known_semantic_passes else None
            )
        validation_dataset_summary = {
            "task": "classification",
            "reference_mode_requested": requested_reference_mode,
            "requested_images": int(len(classification_validation_samples)),
            "images": [str((sample.get("image") or Path("unknown")).name) for sample in classification_validation_samples[: min(32, len(classification_validation_samples))]],
            "variants": proxy_dataset_by_variant,
        }
        if mini_classification_eval_enabled:
            mini_classification_eval_summary = {
                "enabled": True,
                "status": "ok",
                "requested_images": int(len(classification_validation_samples)),
                "variants": mini_classification_eval_by_variant,
                "reference_source": "classification_labels",
            }
        else:
            mini_classification_eval_summary = {
                "enabled": False,
                "status": "disabled",
                "requested_images": int(len(classification_validation_samples)),
                "variants": {},
                "reference_source": "classification_labels",
            }

        if (
            bool(backend_drift_report.get("enabled"))
            and not central_quality_remote_mode
            and not cpu_reference_only_mode
        ):
            drift_dataset_variant = str(backend_drift_report.get("variant") or "")
            drift_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            for sample in classification_validation_samples:
                img_file = sample.get("image")
                if not isinstance(img_file, Path):
                    continue
                row: Dict[str, Any] = {"image": str(img_file.name), "label_id": sample.get("label_id"), "label_name": sample.get("label_name")}
                try:
                    local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1, _local_img_hw = _build_feeds_for_validation_image(img_file)
                    ref_out_local = list(sess_full.run(None, local_feeds_full))
                    ref_names_local = list(output_names)
                    if drift_dataset_variant == "full":
                        out_local = _run_full_variant_outputs(local_feeds_full)
                        out_names_local = list(variant_output_names.get("full") or output_names)
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "part1":
                        out1_map_local = run_stage1_map(local_feeds_p1)
                        p2_in_local = _build_stage2_inputs_cpu(out1_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out2_map_local = _run_stage2_cpu_map(p2_in_local)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out2_map_local)
                        out_local = [out2_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "part2":
                        p1_base_local = sess_p1.run(None, local_feeds_p1)
                        p1_base_map_local = {o.name: a for o, a in zip(sess_p1.get_outputs(), p1_base_local)}
                        p2_inputs_local = _build_stage2_inputs(p1_base_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out_map_local = run_stage2_map(p2_inputs_local)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "composed":
                        out_map_local = run_composed_map(local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    else:
                        continue
                    logits_ref = _classification_logits_vector(list(ref_names_local), list(ref_out_local))
                    logits_out = _classification_logits_vector(list(out_names_local), list(out_local))
                    metrics_img, _ = _proxy_validate_classification(logits_ref, logits_out, topk=5)
                    gt_img = _classification_gt_metrics(logits_out, sample.get("label_id"), topk=5)
                    row["metrics"] = metrics_img
                    row["gt"] = gt_img
                    row["pass"] = bool(metrics_img.get("top1_match"))
                except Exception as e:
                    row["pass"] = False
                    row["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                drift_rows.append(row)
            drift_metrics, drift_pass = _aggregate_classification_dataset_rows(
                drift_rows,
                pass_ratio_thr=float(getattr(args, "validation_pass_image_ratio", 0.8) or 0.8),
            )
            backend_drift_report["dataset"] = {
                "task": "classification",
                "requested_images": int(len(classification_validation_samples)),
                "metrics": drift_metrics,
                "pass": bool(drift_pass),
                "images": drift_rows,
            }
            print(
                f"[validation][backend-drift][dataset] {drift_dataset_variant}@{str(backend_drift_report.get('provider') or '') or 'unknown'} vs cpu_full ({str(backend_drift_report.get('mode') or '') or 'full_vs_cpu_full'}): images={drift_metrics.get('n_images')} "
                f"top1_agreement={drift_metrics.get('top1_agreement')} top5_agreement={drift_metrics.get('top5_agreement')} cosine={drift_metrics.get('mean_cosine_similarity')}"
            )
        elif bool(backend_drift_report.get("enabled")) and (
            central_quality_remote_mode or cpu_reference_only_mode
        ):
            backend_drift_report["dataset"] = {
                "status": (
                    "not_applicable_semantic_reference_generation"
                    if cpu_reference_only_mode
                    else "delegated_to_central_management"
                ),
                "reason": (
                    "self_drift_would_duplicate_canonical_cpu_reference_inference"
                    if cpu_reference_only_mode
                    else "remote_cpu_reference_inference_disabled"
                ),
                "requested_images": int(len(classification_validation_samples)),
            }

    if validation_dataset_images and image_input_name and img_hw is not None:
        print(f"[validation][dataset] semantic proxy validation on {len(validation_dataset_images)} image(s)")
        base_static_full_inputs = {k: np.asarray(v) for k, v in feeds_full.items() if k != image_input_name}
        validation_preprocessing_contract, validation_preprocessing_sha256 = (
            _resolve_image_preprocessing_contract(
                task="detection",
                target_hw=(int(img_hw[0]), int(img_hw[1])),
            )
        )
        # Geometry is a task contract.  Output representation (including BN6)
        # must never select resize vs letterbox.
        val_letterbox = validation_preprocessing_contract["preprocess_mode"] == "letterbox"

        def _build_feeds_for_validation_image(img_file: Path) -> Tuple[Dict[str, np.ndarray], Dict[str, np.ndarray], Tuple[int, int]]:
            local_feeds_full = {k: np.asarray(v) for k, v in base_static_full_inputs.items()}
            arr = _load_image_as_nchw(
                img_file,
                target_hw=img_hw,
                dtype=image_input_dtype,
                scale=str(resolved_image_scale or "norm"),
                letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                preprocessing_contract=validation_preprocessing_contract,
            )
            if arr is None and str(resolved_image_scale or "norm") != "norm":
                arr = _load_image_as_nchw(
                    img_file,
                    target_hw=img_hw,
                    dtype=image_input_dtype,
                    scale="norm",
                    letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                    preprocessing_contract=validation_preprocessing_contract,
                )
            if arr is None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"failed to load validation image {img_file}")
            local_feeds_full[image_input_name] = arr
            local_feeds_p1 = {name: local_feeds_full[name] for name in p1_inputs}
            return local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1, tuple(img_hw)

        def _select_dataset_reference_mode(v: str, ann_exists: bool) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
            warnings: List[str] = []
            vt = str(v or "").strip().lower()
            if central_quality_remote_mode:
                if ann_exists:
                    warnings.append(f"dataset_reference_central_management[{vt}]=annotations_no_remote_cpu")
                    return "annotations", warnings
                warnings.append(f"dataset_reference_central_management[{vt}]=same_backend_full_no_remote_cpu")
                return "same_backend_full", warnings
            if requested_reference_mode == "annotations":
                if ann_exists:
                    return "annotations", warnings
                if _variant_prefers_same_backend_reference(vt):
                    warnings.append(f"dataset_reference_fallback[{vt}]=same_backend_full_missing_annotations")
                    return "same_backend_full", warnings
                warnings.append(f"dataset_reference_fallback[{vt}]=cpu_full_missing_annotations")
                return "cpu_full", warnings
            if requested_reference_mode == "cpu_full":
                return "cpu_full", warnings
            if requested_reference_mode in ("auto", "same_backend_full") and _variant_prefers_same_backend_reference(vt):
                return "same_backend_full", warnings
            if requested_reference_mode == "same_backend_full":
                warnings.append(f"dataset_reference_fallback[{vt}]=cpu_full_no_same_backend_full")
            return "cpu_full", warnings

        proxy_dataset_by_variant: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        mini_coco_ap50_enabled = bool(getattr(args, "mini_coco_ap50", False))
        mini_coco_ap50_by_variant: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        official_coco_cfg = _official_coco_config(plan)
        _validation_root_for_coco = (
            _validation_source_path
            if _validation_source_path is not None and _validation_source_path.is_dir()
            else (_validation_source_path.parent if _validation_source_path is not None else None)
        )
        official_coco_annotations = _official_coco_annotations_path(base_dir, str(getattr(args, "validation_images", "") or ""), official_coco_cfg)
        official_coco_image_ids = _official_coco_image_id_map(_validation_root_for_coco)
        official_coco_by_variant: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        official_coco_reference: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        # Canonical reference and annotations are cached once per image and
        # reused across all candidate variants.
        task_quality_detection_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for v in variants:
            c = comparisons.get(v)
            if not isinstance(c, dict):
                continue
            _quality_output_names_for_variant = list(
                variant_output_names.get(v) or output_names
            )
            _quality_output_values_for_variant = list(
                variant_outputs.get(v) or []
            )
            _quality_output_format_for_variant = (
                _detect_output_format(
                    _quality_output_names_for_variant,
                    _quality_output_values_for_variant,
                )
                if _quality_output_values_for_variant
                else str(output_format or "unknown")
            )
            quality_adapter_mode = _detection_quality_adapter_mode(
                str(c.get("validation_mode_used") or "off"),
                cpu_reference_only=bool(cpu_reference_only_mode),
                output_format=_quality_output_format_for_variant,
            )
            if not quality_adapter_mode:
                continue
            if c.get("status") not in ("ok", "skipped_layout_mismatch"):
                continue
            comparisons[v]["task_quality_semantic_adapter"] = {
                "mode": str(quality_adapter_mode),
                "source_endpoint_role": "canonical_reference_model_output",
                "source_output_format": _quality_output_format_for_variant,
                "source_endpoint_is_raw": bool(
                    _quality_output_format_for_variant in {
                        "multiscale_head", "ultralytics_regcls", "concat",
                        "detr_like", "raw_head", "raw_detection_tensors",
                    }
                ),
                "source_endpoint_has_integrated_nms": (
                    False
                    if _quality_output_format_for_variant in {
                        "multiscale_head", "ultralytics_regcls", "concat",
                        "detr_like", "raw_head", "raw_detection_tensors",
                    }
                    else None
                ),
                "adapter_location": "quality_record_host_postprocessor",
                "canonical_record_endpoint": "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detections",
            }
            if central_quality_remote_mode and str(v).strip().lower() not in {"full", "composed"}:
                technical_gate = _detection_task_quality_gate(
                    gt_by_image={}, candidate_by_image={}, reference_by_image={},
                    variant=v, policy=task_quality_policy, labels=labels,
                )
                task_quality_gate_by_variant[v] = technical_gate
                comparisons[v]["task_quality_gate"] = technical_gate
                comparisons[v]["proxy_dataset"] = {
                    "status": "technical_validation_only",
                    "reason": "part1_part2_are_not_end_to_end_quality_variants",
                    "requested_images": 0,
                }
                continue
            if cpu_reference_only_mode and str(v).strip().lower() != "full":
                continue

            per_image_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            mini_coco_gt_by_image: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            mini_coco_pred_by_image: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            mini_coco_warnings_variant: List[str] = []
            task_quality_gt_by_image: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            task_quality_pred_by_image: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            task_quality_ref_by_image: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
            for img_file in validation_dataset_images:
                row: Dict[str, Any] = {
                    "image": str(img_file.name),
                    "reference_mode_requested": requested_reference_mode,
                }
                try:
                    local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1, local_img_hw = _build_feeds_for_validation_image(img_file)
                    dets_ref = None
                    dets_gt_for_ap50 = None
                    warn_ref: List[str] = []
                    ann_path = _semantic_annotation_sidecar_path(img_file)
                    ann_exists = bool(ann_path.exists())
                    row["annotation_available"] = ann_exists
                    image_key = str(img_file.name)
                    if image_key not in task_quality_detection_cache:
                        cache_entry: Dict[str, Any] = {
                            "gt": None, "gt_original": None,
                            "canonical": None, "canonical_original": None,
                            "warnings": [],
                        }
                        if ann_exists:
                            try:
                                _gt_quality, _gt_quality_warnings = _load_semantic_reference_detections(
                                    img_file, img_hw=local_img_hw, letterbox=bool(val_letterbox), labels=labels
                                )
                                cache_entry["gt"] = list(_gt_quality or [])
                                cache_entry["warnings"].extend(list(_gt_quality_warnings or []))
                                _gt_original, _gt_original_warnings = (
                                    _load_semantic_reference_detections_original(
                                        img_file, labels=labels, preserve_coco=bool(task_quality_policy.get("reporting_policy")),
                                    )
                                )
                                cache_entry["gt_original"] = list(_gt_original or [])
                                cache_entry["warnings"].extend(
                                    list(_gt_original_warnings or [])
                                )
                            except Exception as _gt_exc:
                                cache_entry["warnings"].append(f"task_quality_gt_error={type(_gt_exc).__name__}: {_gt_exc}")
                        if not central_quality_remote_mode:
                            try:
                                _canonical_outputs = list(sess_full.run(None, local_feeds_full))
                                _canonical_dets, _canonical_warnings = _extract_detections_for_proxy(
                                    output_format=output_format, output_names=list(output_names), outputs=_canonical_outputs,
                                    img_hw=local_img_hw, yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf), yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                                    yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det), det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                                    det_iou=float(args.viz_iou), det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det), labels=labels,
                                    model_id=_decoder_model_id,
                                    model_sha256=_decoder_model_sha256,
                                )
                                cache_entry["canonical"] = list(_canonical_dets or [])
                                cache_entry["canonical_original"] = (
                                    _detections_to_original_image_space(
                                        list(_canonical_dets or []),
                                        img_file=img_file,
                                        img_hw=local_img_hw,
                                        letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                                    )
                                )
                                cache_entry["warnings"].extend(list(_canonical_warnings or []))
                            except Exception as _ref_exc:
                                cache_entry["warnings"].append(f"task_quality_canonical_error={type(_ref_exc).__name__}: {_ref_exc}")
                        task_quality_detection_cache[image_key] = cache_entry
                    quality_cache = task_quality_detection_cache.get(image_key) or {}
                    dataset_ref_mode, dataset_ref_warnings = _select_dataset_reference_mode(v, ann_exists)
                    row["reference_mode_used"] = dataset_ref_mode
                    warn_ref.extend(list(dataset_ref_warnings or []))

                    if cpu_reference_only_mode:
                        # The management reference job needs exactly one CPU
                        # inference per image.  Reuse the already-decoded
                        # canonical output instead of running the identical
                        # Full model again as both comparison reference and
                        # candidate.
                        dets_ref = list(quality_cache.get("canonical") or [])
                        warn_ref.extend(list(quality_cache.get("warnings") or []))
                        row["reference_mode_used"] = "cpu_full"
                        row["reference_source"] = "cpu_full_proxy"
                        row["reference_variant"] = "full"
                        row["reference_provider"] = "cpu"
                        row["reference_count"] = int(len(dets_ref))
                    elif dataset_ref_mode == "annotations" and ann_exists:
                        dets_gt = list(quality_cache.get("gt") or [])
                        warn_gt = list(quality_cache.get("warnings") or [])
                        row["reference_source"] = "annotations"
                        row["reference_path"] = str(ann_path.name)
                        row["reference_variant"] = "annotations"
                        row["reference_provider"] = "ground_truth"
                        dets_ref = list(dets_gt or [])
                        dets_gt_for_ap50 = list(dets_gt or [])
                        row["reference_count"] = int(len(dets_ref))
                        warn_ref.extend(list(warn_gt or []))
                    elif dataset_ref_mode == "same_backend_full":
                        ref_out_local = list(_run_full_variant_outputs(local_feeds_full))
                        ref_names_local = list(variant_output_names.get("full") or output_names)
                        dets_ref, warn_ref_proxy = _extract_detections_for_proxy(
                            output_format=output_format,
                            output_names=list(ref_names_local),
                            outputs=list(ref_out_local),
                            img_hw=local_img_hw,
                            yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf),
                            yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                            yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det),
                            det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                            det_iou=float(args.viz_iou),
                            det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det),
                            labels=labels,
                            model_id=_decoder_model_id,
                            model_sha256=_decoder_model_sha256,
                        )
                        warn_ref.extend(list(warn_ref_proxy))
                        row["reference_source"] = "full_same_backend"
                        row["reference_variant"] = "full"
                        row["reference_provider"] = str(full_tok or "")
                        row["reference_count"] = int(len(dets_ref or []))
                    else:
                        dets_ref = list(quality_cache.get("canonical") or [])
                        warn_ref.extend(list(quality_cache.get("warnings") or []))
                        row["reference_source"] = "cpu_full_proxy"
                        row["reference_variant"] = "full"
                        row["reference_provider"] = "cpu"
                        row["reference_count"] = int(len(dets_ref or []))

                    if cpu_reference_only_mode:
                        out_local = []
                        out_names_local = []
                    elif v == "full":
                        out_local = _run_full_variant_outputs(local_feeds_full)
                        out_names_local = list(variant_output_names.get("full") or output_names)
                    elif v == "part1":
                        out1_map_local = run_stage1_map(local_feeds_p1)
                        p2_in_local = _build_stage2_inputs_cpu(out1_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out2_map_local = _run_stage2_cpu_map(p2_in_local)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out2_map_local)
                        out_local = [out2_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    elif v == "part2":
                        p1_base_local = sess_p1.run(None, local_feeds_p1)
                        p1_base_map_local = {o.name: a for o, a in zip(sess_p1.get_outputs(), p1_base_local)}
                        p2_inputs_local = _build_stage2_inputs(p1_base_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out_map_local = run_stage2_map(p2_inputs_local)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    elif v == "composed":
                        out_map_local = run_composed_map(local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1)
                        out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in out_names_local]
                    else:
                        continue

                    _frozen_quality_detections_original = None
                    if (
                        str(v).strip().lower() == "full"
                        and hailo_full_raw_detection_head
                        and _is_hailo(full_tok)
                        and full_primary_timing_scope
                        == "hailo_raw_head_plus_frozen_decode_nms"
                    ):
                        if Image is None or not img_file.is_file():
                            raise RuntimeError(
                                "Hailo Full frozen quality decode lacks source image geometry"
                            )
                        with Image.open(img_file) as _quality_source_image:
                            _quality_original_wh = [
                                int(_quality_source_image.size[0]),
                                int(_quality_source_image.size[1]),
                            ]
                        _frozen_quality_detections_original, _per_image_frozen_contract = (
                            _frozen_hailo_full_quality_candidate(
                                model_id=str(
                                    args.model_id
                                    or args.quality_evidence_model_id
                                    or manifest.get("model_id")
                                    or (plan or {}).get("model_id")
                                    or full_path.stem
                                ),
                                outputs={
                                    str(name): np.asarray(value)
                                    for name, value in zip(
                                        out_names_local, out_local,
                                    )
                                },
                                input_hw=[
                                    int(local_img_hw[0]),
                                    int(local_img_hw[1]),
                                ],
                                original_wh=_quality_original_wh,
                                timed_contract=(
                                    generic_full_frozen_postprocess_contract
                                ),
                            )
                        )
                        row["frozen_quality_original_wh"] = (
                            _quality_original_wh
                        )
                        row[
                            "frozen_quality_postprocess_contract_sha256"
                        ] = str(
                            _per_image_frozen_contract.get(
                                "contract_sha256"
                            ) or ""
                        )
                        row[
                            "frozen_quality_postprocess_invariant_contract_sha256"
                        ] = str(
                            _per_image_frozen_contract.get(
                                "invariant_contract_sha256"
                            ) or ""
                        )

                    if cpu_reference_only_mode:
                        dets_out = list(quality_cache.get("canonical") or [])
                        warn_out = list(quality_cache.get("warnings") or [])
                    else:
                        _candidate_output_format = _detect_output_format(
                            list(out_names_local), list(out_local),
                        )
                        dets_out, warn_out = _extract_detections_for_proxy(
                            output_format=_candidate_output_format,
                            output_names=list(out_names_local),
                            outputs=list(out_local),
                            img_hw=local_img_hw,
                            yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf),
                            yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                            yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det),
                            det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                            det_iou=float(args.viz_iou),
                            det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det),
                            labels=labels,
                            model_id=_decoder_model_id,
                            model_sha256=_decoder_model_sha256,
                        )
                    if cpu_reference_only_mode and quality_adapter_mode == "canonical_cpu_raw_multiscale_adapter":
                        terminal_decode_warnings = [
                            str(warning)
                            for warning in list(warn_out or [])
                            if str(warning).startswith((
                                "proxy_unavailable_output_format",
                                "proxy_decode_exception=",
                                "detr_proxy_decode_exception=",
                                "bn6_decode_failed",
                                "bn6_not_found",
                            ))
                        ]
                        if terminal_decode_warnings:
                            raise RuntimeError(
                                "canonical raw-head detection adapter failed: "
                                + "; ".join(terminal_decode_warnings)
                            )
                    if quality_cache.get("gt_original") is not None:
                        task_quality_gt_by_image[image_key] = list(
                            quality_cache.get("gt_original") or []
                        )
                        if _frozen_quality_detections_original is not None:
                            task_quality_pred_by_image[image_key] = list(
                                _frozen_quality_detections_original
                            )
                        else:
                            task_quality_pred_by_image[image_key] = (
                                _detections_to_original_image_space(
                                    list(dets_out or []), img_file=img_file,
                                    img_hw=local_img_hw,
                                    letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                                )
                            )
                        if quality_cache.get("canonical") is not None:
                            task_quality_ref_by_image[image_key] = list(
                                quality_cache.get("canonical_original") or []
                            )
                            row["task_quality_reference_source"] = "canonical_full_onnx"
                        else:
                            row["task_quality_reference_source"] = "management_cpu_reference_pending"
                    if mini_coco_ap50_enabled:
                        if ann_exists:
                            if dets_gt_for_ap50 is None:
                                dets_gt_for_ap50, warn_gt_ap50 = _load_semantic_reference_detections(
                                    img_file,
                                    img_hw=local_img_hw,
                                    letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                                    labels=labels,
                                )
                                mini_coco_warnings_variant.extend(list(warn_gt_ap50 or []))
                            if dets_gt_for_ap50 is not None:
                                mini_coco_gt_by_image[str(img_file.name)] = list(dets_gt_for_ap50 or [])
                                mini_coco_pred_by_image[str(img_file.name)] = list(dets_out or [])
                        else:
                            mini_coco_warnings_variant.append(f"mini_coco_ap50_missing_annotation={img_file.name}")
                    metrics_img, pass_img = _proxy_validate_detections(dets_ref=dets_ref or [], dets_out=dets_out)
                    row["metrics"] = metrics_img
                    row["pass"] = bool(pass_img)
                    row["warnings"] = list(warn_ref) + list(warn_out)
                except Exception as e:
                    row["pass"] = False
                    row["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                per_image_rows.append(row)

            if (
                _task_quality_execution_location(task_quality_policy)
                == "central_management"
            ):
                _require_complete_detection_candidate_adapter(
                    expected_image_ids=[
                        str(path.name) for path in validation_dataset_images
                    ],
                    candidate_by_image=task_quality_pred_by_image,
                    per_image_rows=per_image_rows,
                )

            agg_metrics, agg_pass = _aggregate_proxy_dataset_results(
                per_image_rows,
                pass_image_ratio_thr=float(args.validation_pass_image_ratio),
            )
            preview_rows = [{
                "image": rr.get("image"),
                "reference_mode_requested": rr.get("reference_mode_requested"),
                "reference_mode_used": rr.get("reference_mode_used"),
                "reference_source": rr.get("reference_source"),
                "reference_variant": rr.get("reference_variant"),
                "reference_provider": rr.get("reference_provider"),
                "reference_path": rr.get("reference_path"),
                "reference_count": rr.get("reference_count"),
                "annotation_available": rr.get("annotation_available"),
                "pass": bool(rr.get("pass")),
                "error": rr.get("error"),
                "metrics": rr.get("metrics"),
                "warnings": list(rr.get("warnings") or []),
            } for rr in per_image_rows[: min(12, len(per_image_rows))]]
            ref_modes = {str(rr.get("reference_mode_used") or "") for rr in per_image_rows if str(rr.get("reference_mode_used") or "")}
            ref_sources = {str(rr.get("reference_source") or "") for rr in per_image_rows if str(rr.get("reference_source") or "")}
            proxy_dataset_by_variant[v] = {
                "images": preview_rows,
                "metrics": agg_metrics,
                "pass": bool(agg_pass),
                "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
                "reference_mode_requested": requested_reference_mode,
                "reference_mode_used": (next(iter(ref_modes)) if len(ref_modes) == 1 else ("mixed" if ref_modes else None)),
                "reference_source": (next(iter(ref_sources)) if len(ref_sources) == 1 else ("mixed" if ref_sources else None)),
            }
            fidelity_pass = bool(comparisons[v].get("passed"))
            comparisons[v]["proxy_single_sample"] = comparisons[v].get("proxy")
            comparisons[v]["proxy_dataset"] = proxy_dataset_by_variant[v]
            comparisons[v]["passed_single_sample"] = fidelity_pass
            comparisons[v]["passed_fidelity"] = fidelity_pass
            comparisons[v]["passed_dataset"] = bool(agg_pass)
            comparisons[v]["passed_combined"] = bool(fidelity_pass and agg_pass)
            if mini_coco_ap50_enabled:
                mini_payload = {
                    "iou_threshold": 0.5,
                    "images": int(len(mini_coco_gt_by_image)),
                    "images_with_annotations": int(len(mini_coco_gt_by_image)),
                    "classes_with_gt": 0,
                    "gt_instances": 0,
                    "predictions": int(sum(len(list(vv or [])) for vv in mini_coco_pred_by_image.values())),
                    "ap50": None,
                    "ap50_by_class": {},
                    "warnings": sorted(set(str(w) for w in mini_coco_warnings_variant if str(w)))[:32],
                }
                if mini_coco_gt_by_image:
                    mini_payload = _mini_coco_ap50_for_variant(
                        gt_by_image=mini_coco_gt_by_image,
                        pred_by_image=mini_coco_pred_by_image,
                        iou_thr=0.5,
                        labels=labels,
                    )
                    mini_payload["warnings"] = sorted(set(str(w) for w in mini_coco_warnings_variant if str(w)))[:32]
                mini_coco_ap50_by_variant[v] = mini_payload
                comparisons[v]["mini_coco_ap50"] = mini_payload
                print(
                    f"[validation][mini-coco-ap50] {v}: ap50={mini_payload.get('ap50')} images={mini_payload.get('images')} classes={mini_payload.get('classes_with_gt')} gt={mini_payload.get('gt_instances')} preds={mini_payload.get('predictions')}"
                )
            quality_gate_variant = _detection_task_quality_gate(
                gt_by_image=task_quality_gt_by_image,
                candidate_by_image=task_quality_pred_by_image,
                reference_by_image=task_quality_ref_by_image,
                variant=v, policy=task_quality_policy, labels=labels,
            )
            if cpu_reference_only_mode:
                reference_errors = [
                    str(row.get("error"))
                    for row in per_image_rows
                    if str(row.get("error") or "").strip()
                ]
                expected_reference_count = int(len(validation_dataset_images))
                observed_reference_count = int(len(task_quality_ref_by_image))
                if reference_errors or observed_reference_count != expected_reference_count:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "canonical detection reference adapter incomplete: "
                        f"expected={expected_reference_count} observed={observed_reference_count} "
                        f"errors={reference_errors[:3]}"
                    )
            detection_quality_contract: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
            # Candidate execution completion is an accelerator-specific
            # attachment.  Keep it separate from the backend-independent
            # canonical Quality Contract, and define the empty value even
            # when central management quality is disabled.
            runtime_completion_contract: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            if _task_quality_execution_location(task_quality_policy) == "central_management":
                if _validation_source_path is None:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "central detection quality requires an explicit validation source"
                    )
                if (
                    str(v).strip().lower() == "full"
                    and hailo_full_raw_detection_head
                    and _is_hailo(full_tok)
                ):
                    if full_primary_timing_scope not in {
                        "hailo_raw_head_plus_hash_bound_onnx_host_tail",
                        "hailo_raw_head_plus_frozen_decode_nms",
                    } or not full_primary_host_tail_sha256:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "generic Hailo Full quality lacks the same timed hash-bound host tail"
                        )
                    if (
                        full_primary_timing_scope
                        == "hailo_raw_head_plus_hash_bound_onnx_host_tail"
                        and not full_output_completion_meta.get(
                            "completed_raw_head_with_host_tail"
                        )
                    ):
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "generic Hailo Full graph host-tail completion was not observed"
                        )
                    runtime_completion_identity = {
                        "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/hailo-full-host-tail-completion",
                        "schema_version": 1,
                        "source_endpoint": "hailo_raw_detection_head",
                        "completed_endpoint": (
                            "source_onnx_terminal_output"
                            if full_primary_timing_scope
                            == "hailo_raw_head_plus_hash_bound_onnx_host_tail"
                            else "decoded_xyxy_score_class_detection_records"
                        ),
                        "timing_scope": full_primary_timing_scope,
                        "postprocess_included_per_timed_frame": True,
                        "endpoint_runtime_attestation_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(
                            full_endpoint_runtime_attestation
                        ),
                        "host_tail_model_name": (
                            str(p2_host_tail_path.name)
                            if p2_host_tail_path is not None else ""
                        ),
                        "host_tail_model_sha256": full_primary_host_tail_sha256,
                        "frozen_postprocess_invariant_contract_sha256": str(
                            generic_full_frozen_postprocess_contract.get(
                                "invariant_contract_sha256"
                            ) or ""
                        ),
                        "frozen_postprocess_contract_sha256": str(
                            generic_full_frozen_postprocess_contract.get(
                                "contract_sha256"
                            ) or ""
                        ),
                        "hailo_hef_sha256": (
                            _sp_file_sha256(hef_full)
                            if hef_full is not None and hef_full.is_file() else ""
                        ),
                    }
                    if not runtime_completion_identity["hailo_hef_sha256"]:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "generic Hailo Full quality lacks exact HEF identity"
                        )
                    if (
                        full_primary_timing_scope
                        == "hailo_raw_head_plus_frozen_decode_nms"
                        and (
                            not runtime_completion_identity[
                                "frozen_postprocess_invariant_contract_sha256"
                            ]
                            or not runtime_completion_identity[
                                "frozen_postprocess_contract_sha256"
                            ]
                        )
                    ):
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "generic Hailo Full quality lacks frozen decoder identity"
                        )
                    runtime_completion_contract = {
                        **runtime_completion_identity,
                        "contract_sha256": _quality_contract_sha256(
                            runtime_completion_identity
                        ),
                    }
                detection_quality_contract = _build_detection_quality_contract(
                    model_path=full_path,
                    validation_source=_validation_source_path,
                    image_ids=sorted(task_quality_pred_by_image),
                    ground_truth_by_image=task_quality_gt_by_image,
                    image_scale=str(resolved_image_scale or "norm"),
                    letterbox=bool(val_letterbox),
                    input_hw=(int(img_hw[0]), int(img_hw[1])),
                    input_dtype=image_input_dtype,
                    output_format=str(output_format or "unknown"),
                    output_names=list(output_names),
                    yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf),
                    yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                    yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det),
                    det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                    det_iou=float(args.viz_iou),
                    det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det),
                    labels=labels,
                    runner_path=Path(__file__).resolve(),
                    endpoint_attestor_sha256=(
                        _verified_suite_vendored_endpoint_attestor_sha256()
                    ),
                )
            _quality_output_names = _quality_output_names_for_variant
            _quality_output_values = _quality_output_values_for_variant
            _quality_terminal_model = (
                full_path if str(v).strip().lower() == "full" else p2_path
            )
            _quality_export_diagnostics: Dict[str, Any] = {}
            _quality_endpoint_declaration = _recorded_suite_endpoint_declaration(
                base_dir=base_dir,
                full_model=full_path,
                terminal_model=_quality_terminal_model,
                variant=str(v),
                provider=(
                    str(full_tok or "")
                    if str(v).strip().lower() == "full"
                    else str(stage2_tok or "")
                ),
                task="detection",
                output_names=_quality_output_names,
                outputs=_quality_output_values,
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            _quality_endpoint = _central_quality_endpoint_contract(
                task="detection",
                output_names=_quality_output_names,
                outputs=_quality_output_values,
                detected_output_format=(
                    _detect_output_format(
                        _quality_output_names,
                        _quality_output_values,
                    ) if _quality_output_values else "unknown"
                ),
                declared_endpoint_contract=_quality_endpoint_declaration,
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            _quality_completed_task_evidence = None
            if (
                str(v).strip().lower() == "full"
                and hailo_full_raw_detection_head
                and _is_hailo(full_tok)
                and full_primary_timing_scope
                == "hailo_raw_head_plus_frozen_decode_nms"
            ):
                if (
                    generic_full_frozen_postprocessor is None
                    or not generic_full_frozen_postprocess_contract
                    or not generic_full_frozen_postprocessor.last_result
                    or not full_runs_ms
                ):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "generic Hailo Full quality lacks its measured "
                        "completed-task result"
                    )
                try:
                    try:
                        from splitpoint_runners.native_detection_postprocess import (
                            build_completed_detection_endpoint_attestation,
                        )
                    except ModuleNotFoundError:
                        from onnx_splitpoint_tool.native_detection_postprocess import (
                            build_completed_detection_endpoint_attestation,
                        )
                    _completed_attestation = (
                        build_completed_detection_endpoint_attestation(
                            generic_full_frozen_postprocess_contract,
                            generic_full_frozen_postprocessor.last_result,
                            completed_frames=len(full_runs_ms),
                            postprocess_completed_frames=len(full_runs_ms),
                            source_endpoint_contract_hash=str(
                                _quality_endpoint.get(
                                    "endpoint_contract_hash"
                                ) or ""
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                except Exception as exc:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "generic Hailo Full completed-task quality "
                        "attestation failed"
                    ) from exc
                _quality_completed_task_evidence = {
                    "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract": (
                        _completed_attestation[
                            "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract"
                        ]
                    ),
                    "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract_hash": (
                        _completed_attestation[
                            "completed_task_comparison_endpoint_contract_hash"
                        ]
                    ),
                    "completed_task_comparison_output_endpoint_id": (
                        _completed_attestation[
                            "completed_task_comparison_output_endpoint_id"
                        ]
                    ),
                    "completed_task_endpoint_attestation": (
                        _completed_attestation
                    ),
                }
            quality_input_request = _export_central_quality_inputs(
                out_dir=out_dir,
                task="detection",
                variant=v,
                policy=task_quality_policy,
                gt_by_image=task_quality_gt_by_image,
                candidate_by_image=task_quality_pred_by_image,
                reference_by_image=task_quality_ref_by_image,
                quality_contract=detection_quality_contract,
                endpoint_contract=_quality_endpoint,
                runtime_precision_identity=_central_quality_runtime_precision_identity(
                    variant=v, full_provider=str(full_tok or ""),
                    stage1_provider=str(stage1_tok or ""),
                    stage2_provider=str(stage2_tok or ""),
                    boundary_mode=str(_boundary_mode or "canonical_float32"),
                    trt_precision=str(getattr(args, "native_trt_precision", "fp16") or "fp16"),
                    full_artifact_path=str(hef_full or "") if 'hef_full' in locals() else "",
                ),
                producer_context=getattr(
                    args, "_quality_evidence_producer_context", None,
                ),
                full_only_quality_identity=getattr(
                    args, "_full_only_quality_identity_context", None,
                ),
                native_split_quality_binding=getattr(
                    args, "_native_split_quality_binding", None,
                ),
                composed_producer_context=(
                    _active_composed_quality_producer_context()
                    if str(v).strip().lower() == "composed"
                    and not cpu_reference_only_mode
                    and not isinstance(
                        getattr(
                            args, "_native_split_quality_binding", None,
                        ), Mapping,
                    )
                    else None
                ),
                candidate_completion_contract=runtime_completion_contract,
                completed_task_evidence=(
                    _quality_completed_task_evidence
                ),
                diagnostics=_quality_export_diagnostics,
            )
            task_quality_input_export_diagnostics_by_variant[v] = dict(
                _quality_export_diagnostics
            )
            if quality_input_request:
                quality_gate_variant["quality_input_request"] = quality_input_request
                task_quality_input_requests_by_variant[v] = quality_input_request
            elif (
                _task_quality_execution_location(task_quality_policy) == "central_management"
                and not cpu_reference_only_mode
                and str(v).strip().lower() in {"full", "composed"}
            ):
                quality_gate_variant.update({
                    "decision": "unavailable",
                    "status": "unavailable",
                    "reason": "central_quality_request_not_emitted",
                    "quality_input_export_status": "failed_closed",
                    "quality_input_export_diagnostics": dict(
                        _quality_export_diagnostics
                    ),
                })
                print(
                    "[central-quality-export][blocked] "
                    f"variant={v} task=detection diagnostics="
                    f"{json.dumps(_quality_export_diagnostics, sort_keys=True)}",
                    flush=True,
                )
            task_quality_gate_by_variant[v] = quality_gate_variant
            if bool(official_coco_cfg.get("enabled")):
                if official_coco_reference is None:
                    official_coco_reference = _official_coco_eval_inline(
                        annotations=official_coco_annotations,
                        pred_by_image=task_quality_ref_by_image,
                        image_ids=official_coco_image_ids,
                        out_dir=out_dir / "official_coco" / "canonical_full_onnx",
                        variant="canonical_full_onnx",
                        cfg=official_coco_cfg,
                    )
                official_variant = _official_coco_eval_inline(
                    annotations=official_coco_annotations,
                    pred_by_image=task_quality_pred_by_image,
                    image_ids=official_coco_image_ids,
                    out_dir=out_dir / "official_coco" / str(v),
                    variant=str(v),
                    cfg=official_coco_cfg,
                )
                official_coco_by_variant[str(v)] = official_variant
                comparisons[v]["official_coco_evaluation"] = official_variant
                print(
                    f"[validation][official-coco] {v}: status={official_variant.get('status')} "
                    f"AP={((official_variant.get('metrics') or {}).get('AP_50_95') if isinstance(official_variant.get('metrics'), dict) else None)}"
                )
            comparisons[v]["task_quality_gate"] = quality_gate_variant
            print(
                f"[quality-gate] {v}: tier={quality_gate_variant.get('tier')} decision={quality_gate_variant.get('decision')} "
                f"metric={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('metric')} delta={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('delta')} "
                f"lcb={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('ci_low')} margin={(quality_gate_variant.get('primary') or {}).get('margin')}"
            )
            print(
                f"[validation][dataset] {v}: ref_mode={proxy_dataset_by_variant[v].get('reference_mode_used')} semantic_pass={agg_pass} fidelity_pass={fidelity_pass} images={agg_metrics.get('n_images')} "
                f"image_pass_ratio={agg_metrics.get('image_pass_ratio')} global_match_ratio={agg_metrics.get('global_match_ratio')} "
                f"global_mean_iou={agg_metrics.get('global_mean_iou_matched')} errors={agg_metrics.get('errors')} inferred={agg_metrics.get('pass_inferred_from_metrics')}"
            )

        if bool(official_coco_cfg.get("enabled")):
            _official_statuses = [str((row or {}).get("status") or "unavailable") for row in official_coco_by_variant.values()]
            _reference_status = str((official_coco_reference or {}).get("status") or "unavailable")
            _required_failure = bool(official_coco_cfg.get("required")) and (
                _reference_status != "ok" or any(status != "ok" for status in _official_statuses)
            )
            official_coco_summary = {
                "enabled": True,
                "required": bool(official_coco_cfg.get("required")),
                "status": "required_unavailable" if _required_failure else ("ok" if _reference_status == "ok" and _official_statuses and all(x == "ok" for x in _official_statuses) else "partial"),
                "annotations": str(official_coco_annotations or ""),
                "reference": official_coco_reference or {"status": "unavailable"},
                "variants": official_coco_by_variant,
                "required_failure": _required_failure,
            }
        else:
            official_coco_summary = {"enabled": False, "required": False, "status": "disabled", "reference": {}, "variants": {}}

        ref_mode = None
        if proxy_dataset_by_variant:
            srcs = {str((blk or {}).get("reference_source") or "") for blk in proxy_dataset_by_variant.values()}
            if len(srcs) == 1:
                ref_mode = next(iter(srcs))
            elif srcs:
                ref_mode = "mixed"
        validation_dataset_summary = {
            "enabled": True,
            "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
            "images": [str(p.name) for p in validation_dataset_images[: min(32, len(validation_dataset_images))]],
            "resolved_scale": str(resolved_image_scale or args.image_scale),
            "reference_mode_requested": requested_reference_mode,
            "reference_source": ref_mode,
            "variants": proxy_dataset_by_variant,
        }
        if mini_coco_ap50_enabled:
            mini_coco_ap50_summary = {
                "enabled": True,
                "status": "ok",
                "iou_threshold": 0.5,
                "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
                "reference_source": "annotations",
                "variants": mini_coco_ap50_by_variant,
                "warnings": [],
            }
        else:
            mini_coco_ap50_summary = {
                "enabled": False,
                "status": "disabled",
                "iou_threshold": 0.5,
                "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
                "reference_source": "annotations",
                "variants": {},
                "warnings": [],
            }

        if (
            bool(backend_drift_report.get("enabled"))
            and not central_quality_remote_mode
            and not cpu_reference_only_mode
        ):
            drift_dataset_variant = str(backend_drift_report.get("variant") or "")
            drift_dataset_provider = str(backend_drift_report.get("provider") or full_tok or "")
            drift_dataset_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            for img_file in validation_dataset_images:
                row: Dict[str, Any] = {
                    "image": str(img_file.name),
                    "reference_source": "cpu_full_proxy",
                    "reference_variant": "full",
                    "reference_provider": "cpu",
                }
                try:
                    local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1, local_img_hw = _build_feeds_for_validation_image(img_file)
                    ref_out_local = list(sess_full.run(None, local_feeds_full))
                    dets_ref_local, warn_ref_local = _extract_detections_for_proxy(
                        output_format=output_format,
                        output_names=list(output_names),
                        outputs=list(ref_out_local),
                        img_hw=local_img_hw,
                        yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf),
                        yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                        yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det),
                        det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                        det_iou=float(args.viz_iou),
                        det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det),
                        labels=labels,
                        model_id=_decoder_model_id,
                        model_sha256=_decoder_model_sha256,
                    )
                    if drift_dataset_variant == "full":
                        drift_out_local = list(_run_full_variant_outputs(local_feeds_full))
                        drift_out_names_local = list(variant_output_names.get("full") or output_names)
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "part1":
                        out1_map_local = run_stage1_map(local_feeds_p1)
                        p2_in_local = _build_stage2_inputs_cpu(out1_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out2_map_local = _run_stage2_cpu_map(p2_in_local)
                        drift_out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out2_map_local)
                        drift_out_local = [out2_map_local[n] for n in drift_out_names_local]
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "part2":
                        p1_base_local = sess_p1.run(None, local_feeds_p1)
                        p1_base_map_local = {o.name: a for o, a in zip(sess_p1.get_outputs(), p1_base_local)}
                        p2_inputs_local = _build_stage2_inputs(p1_base_map_local, feeds_full_override=local_feeds_full)
                        out_map_local = run_stage2_map(p2_inputs_local)
                        drift_out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        drift_out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in drift_out_names_local]
                    elif drift_dataset_variant == "composed":
                        out_map_local = run_composed_map(local_feeds_full, local_feeds_p1)
                        drift_out_names_local = _ordered_out_names(out_map_local)
                        drift_out_local = [out_map_local[n] for n in drift_out_names_local]
                    else:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported backend-drift variant: {drift_dataset_variant}")
                    dets_out_local, warn_out_local = _extract_detections_for_proxy(
                        output_format=output_format,
                        output_names=list(drift_out_names_local),
                        outputs=list(drift_out_local),
                        img_hw=local_img_hw,
                        yolo_conf=float(args.yolo_conf),
                        yolo_iou=float(args.yolo_iou),
                        yolo_max_det=int(args.yolo_max_det),
                        det_conf=float(args.viz_conf),
                        det_iou=float(args.viz_iou),
                        det_max_det=int(args.viz_max_det),
                        labels=labels,
                        model_id=_decoder_model_id,
                        model_sha256=_decoder_model_sha256,
                    )
                    metrics_img, pass_img = _proxy_validate_detections(dets_ref=dets_ref_local or [], dets_out=dets_out_local or [])
                    row["variant"] = drift_dataset_variant
                    row["provider"] = drift_dataset_provider
                    row["metrics"] = metrics_img
                    row["pass"] = bool(pass_img)
                    row["warnings"] = list(warn_ref_local or []) + list(warn_out_local or [])
                except Exception as e:
                    row["variant"] = drift_dataset_variant
                    row["provider"] = drift_dataset_provider
                    row["pass"] = False
                    row["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                drift_dataset_rows.append(row)

            drift_metrics, drift_pass = _aggregate_proxy_dataset_results(
                drift_dataset_rows,
                pass_image_ratio_thr=float(args.validation_pass_image_ratio),
            )
            backend_drift_report["dataset"] = {
                "images": [{
                    "image": rr.get("image"),
                    "reference_source": rr.get("reference_source"),
                    "reference_variant": rr.get("reference_variant"),
                    "reference_provider": rr.get("reference_provider"),
                    "variant": rr.get("variant"),
                    "provider": rr.get("provider"),
                    "pass": bool(rr.get("pass")),
                    "error": rr.get("error"),
                    "metrics": rr.get("metrics"),
                    "warnings": list(rr.get("warnings") or []),
                } for rr in drift_dataset_rows[: min(12, len(drift_dataset_rows))]],
                "metrics": drift_metrics,
                "pass": bool(drift_pass),
                "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
            }
            print(
                f"[validation][backend-drift][dataset] {drift_dataset_variant}@{str(drift_dataset_provider or '') or 'unknown'} vs cpu_full ({str(backend_drift_report.get('mode') or '') or 'full_vs_cpu_full'}): images={drift_metrics.get('n_images')} "
                f"image_pass_ratio={drift_metrics.get('image_pass_ratio')} global_match_ratio={drift_metrics.get('global_match_ratio')} "
                f"global_mean_iou={drift_metrics.get('global_mean_iou_matched')} count_delta_abs={drift_metrics.get('count_delta_abs')}"
            )
        elif bool(backend_drift_report.get("enabled")) and (
            central_quality_remote_mode or cpu_reference_only_mode
        ):
            backend_drift_report["dataset"] = {
                "status": (
                    "not_applicable_semantic_reference_generation"
                    if cpu_reference_only_mode
                    else "delegated_to_central_management"
                ),
                "reason": (
                    "self_drift_would_duplicate_canonical_cpu_reference_inference"
                    if cpu_reference_only_mode
                    else "remote_cpu_reference_inference_disabled"
                ),
                "requested_images": int(len(validation_dataset_images)),
            }

    if primary_variant is not None and primary_variant in task_quality_gate_by_variant:
        task_quality_gate_summary = dict(task_quality_gate_by_variant.get(primary_variant) or {})
    else:
        task_quality_gate_summary = {
            "schema": "onnx-splitpoint/task-quality-gate",
            "schema_version": 2,
            "task": str(effective_benchmark_task or requested_benchmark_task or "auto"),
            "variant": primary_variant,
            "tier": str(task_quality_policy.get("dataset_tier") or "screening"),
            "canonical_reference": str(task_quality_policy.get("canonical_reference") or "canonical_full_onnx"),
            "decision": "unavailable",
            "status": "unavailable",
            "n": 0,
            "reason": "labeled_dataset_gate_not_executed",
            "policy": task_quality_policy,
        }

    def _comparison_available(name: str) -> bool:
        st = comparisons.get(name, {}).get("status")
        return st in ("ok", "skipped_layout_mismatch")

    primary_variant = requested_primary_variant

    semantic_validation_pass = None
    semantic_validation_pass_all = None
    if validation_dataset_summary:
        if primary_variant is not None:
            prim_sem = comparisons.get(primary_variant, {}).get("passed_dataset")
            semantic_validation_pass = (bool(prim_sem) if prim_sem is not None else None)
        any_semantic = False
        semantic_validation_pass_all = True
        for v in variants:
            c = comparisons.get(v)
            if not isinstance(c, dict):
                continue
            if c.get("status") == "skipped":
                continue
            if c.get("status") not in ("ok", "skipped_layout_mismatch"):
                semantic_validation_pass_all = False
                continue
            if "passed_dataset" in c and c.get("passed_dataset") is not None:
                any_semantic = True
                if not bool(c.get("passed_dataset")):
                    semantic_validation_pass_all = False
        if not any_semantic:
            semantic_validation_pass_all = None

    # Overall pass over the requested end-to-end target variants.
    #
    # Part1 and Part2 are diagnostic timing stages; comparing them directly to
    # a full-model output is only meaningful after a completion step and caused
    # misleading final_pass_all=False rows for otherwise valid split runs.
    # Gate on the primary end-to-end target(s): composed when requested, otherwise
    # full.  Still report part1/part2 comparison details, but keep them non-gating.
    gating_variants = [v for v in ("composed", "full") if v in variants]
    if not gating_variants and primary_variant is not None:
        gating_variants = [primary_variant]
    final_pass_all = True
    for v in gating_variants:
        c = comparisons.get(v)
        if not isinstance(c, dict):
            final_pass_all = False
            continue
        if c.get("status") == "skipped":
            continue
        if c.get("status") not in ("ok", "skipped_layout_mismatch"):
            final_pass_all = False
            continue
        if str(c.get("validation_mode_used") or "off") != "off" and not bool(c.get("passed")):
            final_pass_all = False

    # Interface/cut-tensor checks are first-class diagnostics.  Preserve the
    # strict numeric result, but distinguish it from exact structural mapping.
    # A quantized classification cut may be overridden only by a receipt-bound
    # primary composed-vs-CPU-full proxy; unknown evidence is INCONCLUSIVE and
    # structural mapping/shape failures remain hard failures.
    interface_gate_applied = False
    interface_gate_inconclusive = False
    interface_gate_notes: List[str] = []
    native_stage2_binding_evidence: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "exact": False,
        "reason_codes": ["native_stage2_binding_not_evaluated"],
    }
    quantized_interface_gate_decision: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    try:
        iface_pass = interface_checks.get("pass") if isinstance(interface_checks, dict) else None
        if iface_pass is False:
            drift_ds = backend_drift_report.get("dataset") if isinstance(backend_drift_report, dict) else None
            drift_ds_pass = bool(isinstance(drift_ds, dict) and drift_ds.get("pass") is True)
            sem_pass = bool(semantic_validation_pass_all is True or semantic_validation_pass is True)
            stage1_l = str(stage1_tok or "").strip().lower()
            stage2_l = str(stage2_tok or "").strip().lower()
            quantized_stage1 = ("hailo" in stage1_l or "deepx" in stage1_l)
            stage2_accel_l = ("hailo" in stage2_l or "deepx" in stage2_l)
            stage2_gate_available = True
            try:
                if isinstance(stage2_accel_calibration_gate, dict) and stage2_accel_calibration_gate.get("required"):
                    stage2_gate_available = bool(stage2_accel_calibration_gate.get("available"))
            except Exception:
                stage2_gate_available = True
            required_checks = [
                dict(value)
                for value in (interface_checks.get("checks") or {}).values()
                if isinstance(value, Mapping)
                and value.get("required", True) is not False
            ]
            structural_pass = bool(
                required_checks
                and all(check.get("structural_pass") is True for check in required_checks)
            )
            stage1_output_names = [
                str(row.get("out_name") or "")
                for check in required_checks
                for row in list(check.get("per_tensor") or [])
                if isinstance(row, Mapping) and str(row.get("out_name") or "")
            ]
            stage1_output_shapes = {
                str(row.get("out_name") or ""): list(
                    row.get("out_shape") or []
                )
                for check in required_checks
                for row in list(check.get("per_tensor") or [])
                if isinstance(row, Mapping) and str(row.get("out_name") or "")
            }
            native_build_info = (
                dict(getattr(native_p2_sess, "build_info", {}) or {})
                if native_p2_sess is not None else {}
            )
            native_stage2_input_shapes = {
                str(name): list((payload or {}).get("shape") or [])
                for name, payload in dict(
                    (
                        native_p2_sess.describe_io().get("inputs", {})
                        if native_p2_sess is not None else {}
                    ) or {}
                ).items()
                if isinstance(payload, Mapping)
            }
            native_stage2_binding_evidence = (
                _strict_native_split_stage2_binding_evidence(
                    binding=getattr(args, "_native_split_quality_binding", None),
                    receipt=getattr(
